a: Ad sheyyomar love "parati" velo parati".

Rava amar: dechulle alma mode bishtar shekketavo — shetztzarich lekayyeymo, vehacha bechotvin shovar kamippalgi: tanna kamma savar kotvin shovar, verabbi yehuda savar en kotvin shovar. rav ashe amar: mippene shetztzarich lehareoto levaal chov sheni, deamar leh: chazi, gavra defara ana.

Or kede laasot kulei. bea minneh rava merav nachman: hammotzi or, bechamma? amar leh: keditnan: or kede laasot kamea. [hameabbedo, bechamma? amar leh: la shena.] leabbedo bechamma? amar leh: la shena.

Umena temra? — keditnan: hamelabben vehamenappetz vehatztzovea vehattove — shiuro kimlo rochav hassit kaful. vehaoreg shene chutin — shiuro kimlo rochav hassit kaful. alma: kevan delitviyyay kae — shiuro ketavuy. hacha name, kevan dilabbedo kae — shiuro kimubbad. veshello leabbedo, bechamma? amar leh: la shena.

Vela shane ben meubbad lesheeno meubbad? etiveh: hammotzi sammanin sheruyin, kede litzboa bahen dugema leira. veillu besammanin sheenan sheruyin tenan: kelippe egozim ukelippe rimmonin, setes ufua, kede litzboa bahen beged katan [lefi] sevacha! ha ittemar ala, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lefi sheen adam toreach lishrot sammanin litzboa bahen dugema leira.

Vahare zerone ginna, demikkamme dezarinhu tenan: zerone gina pachot mikkigrogeret. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: chamishsha. veillu batar dezarinhu tenan: zevel vechol haddak kede lezabbel bo kelach shel keruv, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: kede lezabbel keresha! — ha ittemar ala, amar rav pappa: ha dizria, ha dela zeria — lefi sheen adam toreach lehotzi nima achat lizria.

Vahare tit, demikkamme deligabbeleh tanya: modim chachamim lerabbi shimon bemotzi shofchin lirshut harabbim sheshshiuran birviit, vehavenan [ba] shofchin lemay chazu? veamar rabbi yirmeya: legabbel bahen et hattit, veillu batar degabbeleh tanya: tit kede laasot (bahen) pi chur! hatam name kedaamaran: lefi sheen adam toreach (bahen) legabbel et hattit laasot bo pi chur.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: shelosha orot hen: matztza, vechippa, vediftera. matztza — kemashmao, dela meliach udela kemiach udela afitz. vechamma shiuro? tane rav shemuel bar rav yehuda: kede latzur bo mishkolet ketanna. vechamma? amar abbaye: riva deriva defumebdita.

Chippa — dimliach vela kemiach vela afitz. vechamma shiuro? keditnan: or — kede laasot kamea. diftera — dimliach ukemiach vela afitz vechamma shiuro? — kede lichtov alav et hagget. katane mihat, kede latzur bo mishkolet ketanna, veamar abbaye: riva deriva defumebdita! hatam bevishshula.

Vehatnan: habbeged — shelosha al shelosha lammidras, hassak — arbaa al arbaa, haor — chamishsha al chamishsha, mappatz — shishsha al shishsha, ben lammidras ben lammet. vetane ala habbeged vehassak vehaor — keshiur lattumea kach shiur lahotzaa! hahu bekuretuvela.
b: Kelaf kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna. ureminhu, kelaf veduchesusetos kede lichtov alav mezuza! may "mezuza" — mezuza shebbattefillin. vekare lehu litfillin "mezuza"? in, vehatanya: retzuot tefillin im hattefillin metammeot et hayyadayim, bifne atzman — en metammeot et hayyadayim. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: hannogea bartzua — tahor, ad sheyyigga bakketzitza. rabbi zakkay mishshemo omer: tahor ad sheyyigga bammezuza atzmah.

Veha middekatane sefa kelaf kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin, shehi "shema yisrael", mikkelal deresha bimzuza atzmah askinan! hachi katane: kelaf veduchesusetos shiuran bechamma? duchesusetos — kede lichtov alav mezuza. kelaf — kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin shehi "shema yisrael".

Amar rav: duchesusetos hare hu kiklaf. ma kelaf kotvin alav tefillin — af duchesusetos kotvin alav tefillin. tenan: kelaf kede lichtov parasha ketanna shebbattefillin shehi "shema yisrael", kelaf — in, duchesusetos la?! lemitzva. ta shema: halacha lemoshe missinay, tefillin al hakkelaf umezuza al duchesusetos. kelaf — bimkom basar, duchesusetos — bimkom sear. lemitzva.

Vehatanya: shinna pasul! ammezuza. vehatanya: shinna baze uvaze pasul! idde veidde ammezuza, veha dechatvinhu akkelaf bimkom sear, i name adduchesusetos bimkom basar. veibbaet ema: shinna baze uvaze tannae hi. detanya shinna baze uvaze — pasul. rabbi acha machshir mishshum rabbi achay bar chanina, veamri la mishshum rabbi yaakov berabbi chanina. rav pappa amar: rav deamar ketanna deve menashshe. detana deve menashshe: ketavah al hanneyayr veal hammatlet — pesula. al hakkelaf veal haggevil veal duchesusetos — keshera.

Ketavah may? illema mezuza — mezuza akkelaf mi katvinan? ella lav — tefillin. velitamaych, tefillin aggevil mi katvinan?! [ella], ki tanya hahi besefer tora. lema mesayyay leh: kayyotze bo, tefillin shebbalu vesefer tora shebbala en osin mehen mezuza, lefi sheen moridin mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla.

Tama deen moridin, ha moridin osin. dichtiva ammay? lav dichtiva adduchesusetos! la, dichtiva al hakkelaf. umezuza akkelaf mi katvinan? in, vehatanya: ketavah al hakkelaf al hanneyayr veal hammatlit — pesula. amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: rabbi meir haya kotvah al hakkelaf, mippene shemmishtammeret. hasheta deatet lehachi, lerav name la tema duchesusetos hare hu kiklaf, ella ema: kelaf hare hu keduchesusetos, ma duchesusetos kotvin alav mezuza — af kelaf kotvin alav mezuza.
Deyo kede lichtov.

a: Tana: shete otiyyot bidyo, shete otiyyot bekulemos, shete otiyyot bekalmarin. bae rava: ot achat bidyo, ot achat bekulemos, ot achat bekalmarin, mahu? teku.

Amar rava: hotzi shete otiyyot uchetavan keshehu mehallech — chayyayv, ketivatan zo hi hannachatan. veamar rava: hotzi ot achat uchetavah, vechazar vehotzi ot achat uchetavah — patur. may tama? beiddana deappeka levatrayyta, chasar leh shiura dekammayyta.

Veamar rava: hotzi chatzi gerogeret achat vehinnicha, vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret achat vehinnicha — rishona naasa kemi shekkelatah [kelev] o shennisrefa, ufatur. veammay? ha mannecha? hachi kaamar: veim kadam vehigbiah rishona kodem hannachat sheniyyay — naaset rishona kemi shennikleta o shennisrefa, ufatur. veamar rava: hotzi chatzi gerogeret vehinnichah, vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret veheevirah derech aleha — chayyayv. veammay? ha la nach! kegon sheheevirah toch shelosha.
Vehaamar rava: toch shelosha lerabbanan tzarich hannacha al gabbe mashshehu! la kashya: kan bezorek, kan bemaavir.

Tanu rabbanan: hotzi chatzi gerogeret vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret, behelem echad — chayyayv, bishte helemot — patur. rabbi yose omer: behelem echad lirshut achat — chayyayv, lishte reshuyot — patur. amar rabba: vehu sheyyesh chiyyuv chattat benehem. aval karmelit — lo.
Abbaye amar: afillu karmelit. aval pisla — lo. verava amar: afillu pisla. veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: reshut shabbat kirshut gittin damya.

Kechol kede lichchol ayin achat. ayin achat ha la kachali! amar rav huna: shekken tzenuot kochalot ayin achat. metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kechol, im lirfua — kede lichchol ayin achat, im lekashshet — bishte enayim. targema hillel bereh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani: ki tanya hahi beiraniyyot.
(Shaava kede litten al pi nekev katan. tana: kede litten al pi nekev katan shel yayin.)
Devek kede litten berosh hashshafshaf. tana: kede litten berosh shafshaf shebberosh kane shel tzayyaydin.
Zefet vegofrit kede laasot kulei. tana: kede laasot nekev katan.

Charsit kede laasot pi chur kulei. lememra deshiura derabbi yehuda nefish? ha kayyma lan deshiura derabbanan nefish, ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: kede littol hemennu middat minal lekatan. ema: kede lasud pitput kira ketanna.
Subbin kede litten al pi chur shel tzorfe zahav.
b: Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi sear kede legabbel bo et hattit. [tit] laasot pi chur shel tzorfe zahav.

Sid kede lasud. tana: kede lasud etzba ketanna shebbabbanot. amar rav yehuda amar rav: benot yisrael shehiggiu lefirkan velo higgiu [leshanim], benot aniyyim — toflot otan besid. benot ashirim — toflot otan besolet, benot melachim — toflot otan beshemen hammor, shenneemar: "shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor". may shemen hammor? rav huna bar chiyyay amar: setachat. rav yirmeya bar abba amar: shemen zayit shello hevi shelish. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: anpiknun — shemen zayit shello hevi shelish. velamma sachin oto — shemmashshir et hassear umeadden habbasar.

Rav bivi haveya leh beratta, tafla ever ever, shekal bah arba mea zuze. hava hahu goy beshivavuteh. haveya leh beratta, tafla bechad zimna umeta. amar: ketal rav bivi livratti. amar rav nachman: rav bivi deshate shichra — baayayn benateh tifla, anan dela shatenan shichra — la baayayn benatan tifla.

Rabbi yehuda omer kede lasud kilkul. may kilkul umay andife? amar rav: tzida uvat tzida. lememra deshiura derabbi yehuda nefish? ha kayyma lan deshiura derabbanan nefish! zuta midderabbanan, unefish midderabbi nechemya. metivi, amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda bechavut, vedivre rabbi nechemya bevetzat hassid. vei salka datach tzida uvat tzida, idde veidde chavut? ella amar rabbi yitzchak, amri deve rabbi amme — aandifa.

Matkif la rav kahana: vechi adam ose meotav anparot?! ella amar rav kahana: shenatot. keditnan: shenatot hayu bahin — ad kan lappar, ad kan laayil, ad kan lakkeves. veibbaet ema: may "andifa" — apputa. vechi ha dehahu bar galil [deikkela levavel], daamaru leh: kum derosh lana bemaase merkava". amar lehu: edrosh lechu kedidrash rabbi nechemya lechavreh. unefaka araita min kutela umechateh beandife umit. vaamaru leh: min dileh da leh.

Mishna adama — kechotam hammartzufin, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: kechotam haiggerot. zevel vachol haddak — kede lezabbel kelach shel keruv, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: kede lezabbel keresha. chol haggas — kede litten al melo kaf sid. kane — kede laasot kulemos. veim haya ave o merussas — kede levashshel bo betza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna bailpas.

Gemara al melo kaf sid. tana: kede litten al pi kaf shel sayyaydin. man tena dechol mealle leh lesid? amar rav chisda: rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: lo yasud adam et beto besid, ella im ken erav bo teven o chol. rabbi yehuda omer: teven muttar, chol asur — mippene shehu terachsid. rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan — kilkulo zehu tikkuno.
Kane kede laasot kulemos. tana: kulemos hammaggia lekishre etzbeotav. bae rav ashe: kesher haelyon o kesher hattachton? teku.

Veim haya ave kulei. tana: terufa beshemen unetuna bailpas. amar leh mar bereh deravina livreh: mi shemia lach betza kalla may hi? amar leh: beata detziltzela. may tama — mishshum dezutera? ema: detzipparta! ishtik. amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? [amar leh: hachi] amar rav sheshet: betzat tarnegolet. umay karu la "betza kalla" — shiaru chachamim, en lach betza kalla levashshel yoter mibbetzat tarnegolet. umay shena kol shiure shabbat kigrogeret vehacha kevetza? amar leh, hachi amar rav nachman: kigrogeret mibbetza kalla.

a: Mishna etzem kede laasot tarvod. rabbi yehuda omer: kede laasot mimmennu chaf. zechuchit — kede ligror bah rosh hakkarker. tzeror o even — kede lizrok baof. rabbi elazar bar yaakov omer: kede lizrok babbehema.

Gemara lememra deshiura derabbi yehuda nefish? ha kayyma lan deshiura derabbanan nefish! amar ulla: chafe potachat. tanu rabbanan: chafe potachat tehorin, kevaan bappotachat temein. veshel gal, af al pi shechibberan baddelet ukevaan bemasmerim tehorin — shekkol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka.
Zechuchit kede ligror bah. tana: sechuchit — kede liftzoa bah shene nimin keachat.
Tzeror o even kede lizrok baof. rabbi elazar kulei. amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shemmargeshet bah. vechamma shiuro? tanya, rabbi elazar ben yaakov omer: mishkal asara zuz.

Zunin al leve midresha, amar lehu: rabbotay, avanim shel bet hakkisse shiuran bechamma? amru lo: kezayit keegoz uchevetza. amar lehu: vechi turetane yachnis? nimnu vegamru melo hayyad. tanya, rabbi yose omer: kezayit keegoz uchevetza. rabbi shimon berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: melo hayyad.

Tanu rabbanan beshabbat: shalosh avanim mekurezalot muttar lehachenis levet hakkisse. vechamma shiuran? rabbi meir omer: keegoz. rabbi yehuda omer: kevetza. amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: kammachaloket kan kach machaloket beetrog. hatam matnitin, hacha barayyta! ella: kammachaloket beetrog kach machaloket kan.

Amar rav yehuda: aval lo et happayes. may "payes"? amar rabbi zera: karshine bavlayayta. amar rava: asur lemashmesh bitzror beshabbat kederech shemmemashmesh bachol. matkif la mar zutera: listakkan? kilachar yad. amar rabbi yannay: im yesh makom kavua levet hakkisse — melo hayyad. im lav — kahechrea medocha ketanna shel besamim. amar rav sheshet: im yesh aleha ed — muttar.

Metivi? asara devarim meviin et haadam lide tachtoniyyot, veellu hen: haochel ale kanim, vaale gefanim, velulabbe gefanim, umorigge vehema belo melach, veshidro shel dag, vedag maliach shello bishshel kol tzorko, vehashshote shimre yayin, vehamekanneach besid, uvecharsit, vehamekanneach bitzror shekkinnach bo chavero. veyesh omrim: af hattole atzmo bevet hakkisse. la kashya: ha belach, ha beyavesh. veibbaet ema: kan mitztzad echad, vechan mishshene tzedadin. veibbaet ema: ha dideh, ha dechavreh.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: yardu aleha geshamim venittashteshu mahu? amar leh: im haya rishshuman nikkar — muttar.
Bea minneh rabbah bar rav shela merav
b: Chisda: mahu lehaalotam acharav laggag? amar leh: gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et "lo taase" shebbattora. yatev marimar vekaamar la leha shemata. etiveh ravina lemarimar: rabbi eliezer omer notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachatzot bo shinnav, vachachamim omrim lo yittol ella min haevus shel behema! hachi hasheta?! hatam — adam kovea makom lisuda, hacha — adam kovea makom levet hakkisse?

Amar rav huna: asur lippanot bisde nir beshabbat. may tama? illema mishshum davvsha — afillu bechol name! veella mishshum asavim, vehaamar resh lakish: tzeror shealu bo asavim — muttar lekanneach bo. vehattolesh mimmenna beshabbat — chayyayv chattat. ella dilma naket meillay veshade letattay, umichayyayv mishshum derabba. deamar rabba: hayta lo gumma utemamah, babbayit — chayyayv mishshum bone, bassade — chayyayv mishshum choresh.

Gufa, amar resh lakish: tzeror shealu bo asavim — muttar lekanneach bo. vehattolesh mimmenna beshabbat — chayyayv chattat. amar rav pappe: shema minna midderesh lakish, hay parpisa — shere letaltoleh. matkif la rav kahana: im amru letzorech, yomru shello letzorech?! amar abbaye: parpisa, hoil vaata leyadan lema beh milleta: haya munnach al gabbe karka vehinnicho al gabbe yetedot — chayyayv mishshum tolesh. haya munnach al gabbe yetedot vehinnicho al gabbe karka — chayyayv mishshum notea.

Amar rabbi yochanan: asur lekanneach becheres beshabbat. may tama? illema mishshum sakkana — afillu bechol name! veella mishshum keshafim — afillu bechol name la! veella mishshum hashsharat nimin — davar sheen mitkavven hu. amar lehu rav natan bar oshaya: gavra rabba amar milleta, nema bah tama: la mibbaya bechol — deasur, aval beshabbat — hoil veikka torat keli alav, shappir dame. ka mashma lan.

Rava matne la mishshum hashsharat nimin, vekashya leh derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan: mi amar rabbi yochanan asur lekanneach bacheres beshabbat? alma davar sheen mitkavven — asur. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna. utenan: nazir chofef umefaspes, aval lo sorek! ella mechavvavrta kidrav natan bar oshaya.

May keshafim? ki ha derav chisda verabba bar rav huna havo ka azli bearba, amara lehu hahi matronita: otvan bahadayychu! vela otvuha. amara ihi milleta — asarta learba. amaru inhu milleta — sharyuha. amara lehu: may ebed lechu?

a: Dela mikkannach lechu bechaspa, vela ketil lechu kinna ammanayychu, vela shelif lechu yarka vaachil lechu mikkishsha deasar ginnaa.

Amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: may tama la shechichat kammeh derav chisda, dimchaddedan shematateh? amar leh: may ezil legabbeh? dechi azelna legabbeh motiv li bemille dealma. amar li: man deayel levet hakkisse la littev behedya, vela litrach tefe — dehay karkashta attelat shinne yatev, dilma mishtamti shinne decharkashta veate lide sakkana. amar leh: hu asek bechayye divriyyayta veat amrat bemille dealma?! kol shekken zil legabbeh.

Hayu lefanav tzeror vacheres, rav huna amar: mekanneach batztzeror veen mekanneach bacheres, verav chisda amar: mekanneach bacheres veen mekanneach batztzeror. metivi: hayu lefanav tzeror vacheres — mekanneach bacheres veen mekanneach batztzeror, teyuveta derav huna! targema rafram bar pappa kammeh derav chisda allibba derav huna: beogne kelim.

Hayu lefanav tzeror vaasavim, rav chisda verav hamenuna, chad amar: mekanneach batztzeror veen mekanneach baasavim, vechad amar: mekanneach baasavim veen mekanneach batztzeror. metivi: hamekanneach bedavar shehaur sholetet bo shinnav hattachtonot noshrot! la kashya: ha belachin, ha biveshin.

Hannitzrach lippanot veeno nifne, rav chisda veravina, chad amar: ruach raa sholetet bo, vechad amar: ruach zuhama sholetet bo. tanya keman deamar ruach zuhama sholetet bo, detanya: hannitzrach linkavav veochel — dome letannur shehissikuhu al gav efro, vezo hi techillat ruach zuhama.

Hutzerach lippanot veeno yachol lippanot, amar rav chisda: yaamod veyeshev, yaamod veyeshev. rav chanan minnehardea amar: yistallek litzdadin. rav hamenuna amar: yemashmesh bitzror beoto makom. verabbanan amri: yassiach dato. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kol shekken dechi massach dateh la mippene! amar leh: yassiach dato middevarim acherim. amar rav yirmeya middifti: ledidi chaze li hahu tayyaya dekam veyatev vekam veyatev ad deshafech kekidra.
Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas lisudat keva, yehallech eser peamim shel arba [arba] ammot, veamri la: arba peamim shel eser eser ammot, venifne, venichnas veyoshev bimkomo.

Mishna cheres — kede litten ben patztzim lachavero, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: kede lachtot bo et haur. rabbi yose omer: kede lekabbel bo reviit. amar rabbi meir: af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "lo yimmatze vimchittato cheres lachtot esh miyyakud". amar lo rabbi yose: mishsham reaya? "velachsof mayim miggeve".

Gemara ibbaya lehu: shiura derabbi meir nefish, o shiura derabbi yose nefish? missevara — shiura derabbi yose nefish, umikkera — shiura derabbi meir nefish. dei salka datach shiura derabbi yose nefish, layet la bemana zutera, vahadar layet la bemana rabba?! amar abbaye: [matnitin name] lachtot esh mikida gedola.

Rabbi yose omer: mishsham reaya. shappir kaamar leh rabbi yose lerabbi meir! verabbi meir "la mibbaya" kaamar: la mibbaya midde dachashiv leinashe dela lishtechach leh, ella afillu midde dela chashiv leinashe la lishtechach leh.
Haderan alach hammotzi yayin
Mishna amar rabbi akiva: minnayin laavoda zara shemmetammea bemassa kenidda, shenneemar: "tizrem kemo dava tze tomar lo" — ma nidda metammea bemassa, af avoda zara metammea bemassa.
Gemara tenan hatam: mi shehaya beto samuch laavoda zara venafal, asur livnoto. ketzad yaase? kones letoch shello arba ammot uvone.
b: Haya shello veshel avoda zara, niddon mechetza al mechetza. avanav veetzav vaafarav metammeim kesheretz, shenneemar: "shakketz teshakketzennu vegomer". rabbi akiva omer kenidda, shenneemar: "tizrem kemo dava" — ma nidda metammea bemassa, af avoda zara metammea bemassa. amar rabba: "tizrem" deamar kera, nakkerinhu minnach kezar. "tze tomar lo" — hikkanes al tomar lo.

Veamar rabba: bemassa dechulle alma la peligi dimtammea, deha ittakkash lenidda. ki peligi beeven mesama. rabbi akiva savar kenidda: ma nidda metammea beeven mesama — af avoda zara metammea beeven mesama. verabbanan savri kesheretz: ma sheretz lo metamme beeven mesama — af avoda zara lo metammea beeven mesama.

Ulerabbi akiva, lemay hilcheta ittakkash lesheretz? — limshammesheha. ulerabbanan, lemay hilcheta ittakkash lenidda? — lemassa. velakkesheh rachamana linvela! in hachi name, ella: ma nidda enah leevarin, af avoda zara enah leevarin. veella ha devae rav chama bar gureya: avoda zara yeshnah leevarin o enah leevarin? tifshot leh meha, dilrabbanan enah leevarin! rav chama bar gureya allibba derabbi akiva bae la.

Verabbi elazar amar: beeven mesama dechulle alma la peligi dela metammea. ki peligi bemassa: rabbi akiva savar kenidda, ma nidda metammea bemassa — af avoda zara metammea bemassa. verabbanan savri kesheretz, ma sheretz lo metamme bemassa — af avoda zara lo metammea bemassa. verabbi akiva, lemay hilcheta ittakkash lesheretz? limshammesheha. verabbanan lemay hilcheta ittakkash lenidda? ma nidda enah laevarim, af avoda zara enah leevarim.

a: Verabbi akiva lemay hilcheta ittakkash lenidda? — lemassa, lavkkesheh linvela! in, hachi name. ella: ma nidda enah leevarin, af avoda zara enah leevarin. ella ha devae rav chama bar gureya: avoda zara yeshnah leevarim o enah leevarim — tifshot leh meha ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi akiva deenah leevarim! rav chama bar gureya kerabba matne, uvae la allibba derabbi akiva.

Metivi: avoda zara kesheretz umeshammesheha kesheretz. rabbi akiva omer: avoda zara kenidda umeshammesheha kesheretz. bishlama lerabbi elazar nicha, ella lerabba kashya! amar lach rabba: mi allima mimmatnitin, dekatane: "etzav vaavanav vaafarav metammein kesheretz", veokimna, may kesheretz — dela metamme beeven mesama, hacha name dela metamme beeven mesama.

Metivi: nachri venochrit, avoda zara umeshammesheha — hen velo hessetan. rabbi akiva omer: hen vehessetan. bishlama lerabbi elazar nicha, ella lerabba kashya. amar lach rabba: velitamaych nachri venochrit name, hen velo hessetan?! vehatanya: "dabber el bene yisrael vegomer" — bene yisrael metammein beziva veen goyim metammein beziva, aval gazru alehen sheyyehu kezavin lechol divrehen.

Ella rabba metaretz letameh: nachri venochrit — hen vehessetan veeven mesama shellahen. avoda zara — hi vehessetah, aval lo even mesama shellah. rabbi akiva omer: avoda zara — hi vehessetah veeven mesama shellah. verabbi elazar metaretz letameh: nachri venochrit — hen vehessetan veeven mesama shellahen. avoda zara — hi velo hessetah. verabbi akiva omer: avoda zara — hi vehessetah.

Matkef la rav ashe: may "hen"? ella amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: goy vegoyah, ben hen shehesitu et acherim uven acherim shehesitu otan — temeim. avoda zara shehesita acherim — tehorin, acherim shehesitu otah — temeim. meshammesheha, ben hen shehesitu et acherim uven acherim shehesitu otan — tehorim. rabbi akiva omer: goy vegoyah vaavoda zara, ben hen shehesitu et acherim uven acherim shehesitu otan — temeim. meshammesheha, ben hen shehesitu acherim uven acherim shehesitu otan — tehorin.

Avoda zara, bishlama acherim shehesitu otah — mashkachat la. ella hi shehesita et acherim hechi mashkachat la? amar rame bereh derav yeva, keditnan: hazzav bechaf moznayim, vaochalin umashkin bechaf sheniyyay, kara hazzav — temein,
b: Karu hen tehorin. keman azla ha detanya kol hattumot hammesitot tehorot, chutz mehesseto shel zav shello matzinu lo chaver bechol hattora kullah — lema dela kerabbi akiva, dei kerabbi akiva — ikka name avoda zara! afillu tema rabbi akiva, tena zav vechol dedame leh.

Bae rav chama bar gureya: avoda zara yeshnah leevarim, o enah leevarim? hecha dehedyot yachol lehachazirah — la tibbee lach, dichman dimchabbera dame. ki tibbee lach hecha deen hedyot yachol lehachazirah, may? kevan deen hedyot yachol lehachazirah — keman demittavra dame, o dilma ha la mechassera. veikka devae la lehach gisa: hecha deen hedyot yachol lehachazirah — la tibbee lach, dichman demittavra dame, ki tibbee lach hecha dehedyot yachol lehachazirah, may? kevan dehedyot yachol lehachazirah — keman dimchabbera dame, o dilma hasheta mihat ha mishshalfa veshadya, teku.

Bae rav achadvuy bar amme: avoda zara pechuta mikkezayit, mahu? matkif la rav yosef: lemay? ilema leinyan issura, lo yehe ella zevuv baal ekron. detanya: "vayyasimu lahem baal berit leelohim", ze zevuv baal ekron. melammed shekkol echad veechad ose demut yirato umannichah betoch kiso, kevan shezzochrah motziah mittoch kiso umechabbekah umenashshekah. ella leinyan tumea may? kevan deittakkash lesheretz: ma sheretz bechaadasha, af avoda zara name bechaadasha. o dilma, ha ittakkash lemet: ma met bichzayit, af avoda zara bichzayit.

Amar rav avya veittema rabba bar ulla, ta shema detanya: avoda zara pechuta mikkezayit en bah tumea kol ikkar, shenneemar: "vayyashlech et afarah el kever bene haam" — ma met bichzayit, af avoda zara bichzayit.

Verabbanan, lemay hilcheta ittakkash lesheretz — dela metamme bemassa, lenidda — deenah leevarin, lemet — dela metamme bechaadasha. ema lechumera: lemay hilcheta akkesha rachamana lesheretz — letammoye bechaadasha, lenidda — letammoye beeven mesama, akkesha rachamana lemet — letammoye beohel! tumeat avoda zara derabbanan hi, vekulla vechumera — lekulla makkeshinan, lechumera la makkeshinan.
Mishna minnayin lisfina shehi tehora — shenneemar: "derech oniyya velev yam".

Gemara peshita, oniyya belev yam hi! ha ka mashma lan keyam: ma yam tahor — af sefina tehora. tanya, chananya omer: nilmedenna missak, ma sak mittaltel male verekan — af kol mittaltel male verekan. leappoke sefina, deenah mittaltelet melea.

May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu sefina shel cheres. man deamar "oniyya belev yam", ha name belev yam hi. leman deamar kesak — hanach hu dichtivi gabbe sak, dei mittaltel male verekan in, i la — la. aval sefina shel cheres, af al gav deenah mittaltelet melea.

I name sefinat hayyarden. leman deamar oniyya belev yam hi — ha name oniyya belev yam hi. leman deamar mittaltelet male verekan — ha name mittaltelet melea verekanit. deamar rabbi chanina ben akavya: mippene ma amru sefinat hayyarden temea — mippene shettoanim otah bayyabbasha, umoridin otah lammayim. amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam al yimna adam et atzmo mibbet hammidrash vaafillu shaa achat, shehare kamma shanim nishnet mishna zo bevet hammidrash velo nitgalla tamah ad shebba rabbi chanina ben akavya ufershah.

Amar rabbi yonatan: leolam al yimna adam et atzmo mibbet hammidrash umiddivre tora vaafillu bishat mita, shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel" — afillu bishat mita tehe osek battora. amar resh lakish: en divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo aleha, shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel". amar rava

a: Velachananya tiltul al yede shevavrim shemeh tiltul? in ditnan: shalosh agalot hen. asuya kekatedra — temea midras. kemitta — temea teme met. shel avanim — tehora mikkelum. veamar rabbi yochanan: veim yesh bah bet kibbul rimmonim, temea teme met.
Shalosh tevot hen: teva sheppitchah mitztziddah — temea midras. millemala — temea teme met. vehabbaa bemidda, tehora mikkelum.

Tanu rabbanan: midras keli cheres tahor. rabbi yose omer: af hassefina. may kaamar? amar rav zevid, hachi kaamar: midras keli cheres — tahor, umaggao tame, usefina shel cheres temea kachananya. rabbi yose omer: af hassefina tehora, ketanna didan. matkif la rav pappa: may "af"? ella amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: midras keli cheres — tahor, umaggao tame. veshel etz, ben midraso uven maggao — tame, usefinat hayyarden — tehora ketanna didan. rabbi yose omer: af hassefina temea, kachananya.
Umidras keli cheres menalan detahor? amar chizkiyya, deamar kera: "veish asher yigga bemishkavo", makkish mishkavo lo: ma hu it leh tohora bemikve — af mishkavo name it leh tohora bemikve.

Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "kemishkav niddatah yihye lah", makkish mishkavah lah: ma hi it la tohora bemikve — af mishkavah name it la tohora bemikve, leappoke keli cheres delet leh tohora bemikve. metiv rabbi ila: mappatz bemet minnayin?
b: Vedin hu: uma pakkin ketannim shettehorin bezav — temeim bemet, mappatz shettame bezav, eno din sheyyehe tame bemet?! veammay, ha let leh tohora bemikve! amar leh rabbi chanina: shane hatam hoil veikka bemino.

Amar leh: rachamana litzlan mehay data: adderabba, rachamana litzlan middata didach. vetama may — tere kerae ketivi. ketiv: "veish asher yigga bemishkavo", uchetiv: "vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav hazzav yitma". ha ketzad? yesh bemino, af al gav delet leh tohora bemikve. en bemino, makkish mishkavo lo.

Rava amar: midras keli cheres tahor mehacha: "vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav", ha yesh tzemid patil alav — tahor hu. mi la askinan deyachadinhu leishto nidda, vekaamar rachamana tahor!

Mishna minnayin laaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim shezzorin betochah chamishsha zeronin, arbaa al arba ruchot haaruga veachat baemtza, shenneemar: "ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah ucheganna zerueha tatzmiach" — "zarah" lo neemar, ella "zerueha".
Gemara may mashma? amar rav yehuda: "ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah". "totzi" — chad, "tzimchah" — chad, hare tere. "zerueha" — tere, ha arbea. "tatzmiach" — chad, ha chamsha.

a: Vekim lehu lerabbanan dechamsha beshitta la yanki mehadade.

Umenalan deha dekim lehu lerabbanan dechamsha beshitta milleta hi? deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv: "lo tassig gevul reacha [asher gavlu rishonim]" — gevul sheggavlu rishonim lo tassig. may "gavlu rishonim"? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "elle vene seir hachori yoshve haaretz", attu kulle alma yoshve rakia ninhu?! ella shehayu bekiin beyishshuvah shel eretz, shehayu omrim: melo kane ze lezayit, melo kane ze ligfanim, melo kane ze litenim. vechori" — shemmerichim et haaretz. vechivvi", amar rav pappa: shehayu toamin et haaretz kechivya. rav acha bar yaakov amar: "chori" — shennaasu bene chorin minnichsehen.

Amar rav assi: aruga — tochah shishsha chutz miggevuleha. tanya name hachi: aruga tochah shishsha. gevuleha bechamma? keditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: rochav — kimlo rochav parsa. amar rabbi zera, veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: may tama derabbi yehuda — dichtiv: "vehishkita veraglecha kegan hayyarak" — ma regel tefach, af gevul name tefach.
Amar rav: aruga — bechureba shaninu. vehaikka makom keranot! amri be rav mishshemeh derav: bimmalle et hakkeranot. velizra meabbaray vela limalle miggavvay!
b: Gezera shemma yemalle et hakkeranot. velo yehe ella rosh tor yarak? mi la tenan: haya rosh tor yarak nichnas letoch sade acher — muttar, mippene shennire sof sade! en rosh tor baaruga.
Ushemuel amar: aruga ben haarugot shaninu. veha ka mitarvi bahadade! benote shura lechan veshura lechan.

Amar ulla, beo bemareva: hifkia telem echad al pene kullah, mahu? amar rav sheshet: ba irbuv uvittel et hashshura. rav assi amar: en eruvo mevattel et hashshura. etiveh ravina lerav ashe: hannotea shete shurot shel kishshuin, shete shurot shel dilluin, shete shurot shel pol hammitzri — muttar. shura achat shel kishshuin veshura achat shel dilluin veshura achat shel pol hammitzri — asur! shane hacha deikka sheracha.
Amar rav kahana amar rabbi yochanan: harotze lemallovt kol ginnato yarak — ose aruga shishsha al shishsha veogel bah chamishsha, umemalle karnoteha kol ma sheyyirtze.

Veha ikka devene uvene! amri deve rabbi yannay: bemachariv ben habbenayim. rav ashe amar: im hayu zeruin sheti — zoran erev, erev — zoran sheti. etiveh ravina lerav ashe: avodat yarak beyarak acher, shishsha tefachim. veroin otam

a: Ketavla merubbaat. ketavla hu dishre, ha lav hachi — asur! hatam leakkole bah kulla acharina, lehattir rosh tor hayyotze hemenna.

Mishna minnayin lefoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi shettehe temea? shenneemar: "heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim". minnayin shemmarchitzin et hammila bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat? shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim". minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach? shenneemar: "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu". minnayin lesicha shehi kishtiyyay beyom hakkippurim? af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav".

Gemara resha dela kerabbi elazar ben azarya, sefa kerabbi elazar ben azarya? dei kerabbi elazar ben azarya — tehora shemana leh. man dela moke ketannae, tane resha "tehora", umoke la lechulla kerabbi elazar ben azarya, uman demokem ketannae, resha rabbanan vesefa kerabbi elazar ben azarya.

Tanu rabbanan: poletet shichvat zera beyom hashshelishi tehora, divre rabbi elazar ben azarya. rabbi yishmael omer: peamim shehen arba onot, peamim shehen chamesh onot, peamim shehen shesh onot. rabbi akiva omer: leolam chamesh, veim yatzata miktzat ona rishona, notnin lah miktzat ona shishshit.

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa, veamri la rav pappa lerava: bishlama rabbi elazar ben azarya kerabbanan — deamri bechamsha avud perisha, verabbi yishmael kerabbi yose — deamar bearbea avud perisha, ella rabbi akiva keman? leolam kerabbi yose, kidamar rav adda bar ahava: moshe behashekama ala uvehashkama yarad.

Behashekama ala, dichtiv: "vayyashkem moshe vabboker vayyaal el har sinay". behashekama yarad, dichtiv: "lech red vealita atta veaharon immach", makkish yerida laaliyyay: ma aliyyay behashekama, af yerida behashekama.

Lema leh lememra lehu, veha amar rav huna: yisrael kedoshim hen veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom! ha amar rava: im haya bayit afel — muttar. veamar rava veittema rav pappa: talmid chacham maafil betallito, umuttar.
b: Veha tevule yom ninhu? abbaye bar ravin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvavyyhu: nittena tora litvul yom. yatev marimar vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh ravina lemarimar: nittena kaamrat, o reuya kaamrat? amar leh: reuya kaamena.

Velitbelu bene shimshe, velikabbelu tora bene shimshe? amar rabbi yitzchak: "lo merosh basseter dibbarti". velitbelu betzafra deshabbeta, velikabbelu tora betzafra deshabbeta? amar rabbi yitzchak: shello yehe hallalu holchin lekabbel tora vehallalu holchin litvila.

Amar rabbi chiyyay berabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: shesh onot shelemot baenan. amar rav chisda: machaloket sheppersha min haishsha, aval persha min haish — temea kol zeman shehi lacha. metiv rav sheshet: "vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara" — perat leshichvat zera shehi serucha. may lav sheppersha min haish? la, sheppersha min haishsha.

Bae rav pappa: shichvat zera shel yisrael bime goya mahu? yisrael didigi bemitzvot — chavil gufayyhu, goyim dela deigi bemitzvot — la. o dilma: kevan deachlin shekatzim uremasim chavil gufayyhu. veim timtze lomar kevan deachli shekatzim uremasim chavil gufayyhu: bime behema mahu? ishsha hi deit la perozdor — masrecha, aval behema delet la perozdor — la, o dilma la shena. teku.

Tanu rabbanan: beshishshi bachodesh nittenu aseret haddibberot leyisrael. rabbi yose omer: beshiva bo. amar rava: dechulle alma berosh chodesh ato lemidbar sinay. ketiv hacha: "bayyom hazze bau midbar sinay", uchetiv hatam: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim" — ma lehallan rosh chodesh, af kan rosh chodesh. udechulle alma, beshabbat nittena tora leyisrael. ketiv hacha: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho", uchetiv hatam: "vayyomer moshe el haam zachor et hayyom hazze" — ma lehallan beitztzumo shel yom, af kan beitztzumo shel yom. ki peligi bikvia deyarcha: rabbi yose savar — bechad beshabba ikkeva yarcha, uvechad beshabba la amar lehu vela midde mishshum chulesha deorcha; bitre beshabba amar lehu: "veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim";

a: Bitlata amar lehu mitzvat hagebala; bearbea avud perisha. verabbanan savri — bitre beshabba ikkeva yarcha, bitre beshabba la amar lehu vela midde mishshum chulesha deorcha; bitlata amar lehu: "veattem tihyu li"; bearbea amar lehu mitzvat hagebala; bechamsha avud perisha. metivi: "vekiddashtam hayyom umachar", kashya lerabbi yose!

Amar lecha rabbi yose: yom echad hosif moshe middato. detanya: shelosha devarim asa moshe middato, vehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu immo. hosif yom echad middato, uferash min haishsha, veshavar et halluchot.

Hosif yom echad middato, may derash? "hayyom umachar" — hayyom kemachar. ma lemachar lelo immo, af hayyom lelo immo. velayla dehaiddana nefak leh, shema minna tere yome levar mehaiddana. umenalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado — dela sheray shechina ad tzafra deshabbeta.

Uferash min haishsha, may derash? nasa kal vachomer beatzmo, amar: uma yisrael shello dibbera shechina immahen ella shaa achat, vekava lahen zeman, amra tora: "vehayu nechonim vegomer al tiggeshu". ani, shekkol shaa veshaa shechina medabberet immi, veeno kovea li zeman — al achat kamma vechamma. umenalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado? — dichtiv: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem", uchetiv batreh: "veatta po amod immadi". veit deamri: "pe el pe adabber bo".

Shavar et halluchot, may derash? amar: uma pesach shehu echad mittaryag mitzvot, amra tora: "vechol ben nechar lo yochal bo". hattora kullah [kan] veyisrael meshummadim — al achat kamma vechamma. umenalan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu al yado? — shenneemar: "asher shibbarta", veamar resh lakish: yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta.

Ta shema: "vehayu nechonim layyom hashshelishi", kashya lerabbi yose. ha amrinan yom echad hosif moshe middato. ta shema: "shelishi" — shelishi bachodesh ushelishi bashshabbat, kashya lerabbanan! amri lach rabbanan: ha manni — rabbi yose hi.
Shelishi lemay? lechidtanya: "vayyashev moshe et divre haam el Adonai", uchetiv: "vayyagged moshe et divre haam el Adonai".

Ma amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, uma amar lahem moshe leyisrael, uma amru yisrael lemoshe, uma heshiv moshe lifne haggevura? zo mitzvat hagebala, divre rabbi yose bar yehuda. rabbi omer: battechilla peresh onshah, dichtiv: "vayyashev moshe" — devarim shemmeshabbevin dato shel adam, ulevassof peresh mattan secharah, dichtiv: "vayyagged moshe" — devarim shemmoshchin libbo shel adam keaggada. veikka deamri: battechilla peresh mattan secharah, dichtiv: "vayyashev moshe" — devarim shemmeshivin dato shel adam, ulevassof peresh onshah, dichtiv: "vayyagged moshe" — devarim shekkashin laadam kegiddin.
Ta shema: "shishshi" — shishshi bachodesh, shishshi bashshabbat, kashya lerabbanan! ha name rabbi yose hi. shishshi lemay? rava amar:
b: Lachaniyyaytan, rav acha bar yaakov amar: lemassaan. vekamippalgi beshabbat demara. dichtiv: "kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: "kaasher tzivvecha" — bemara. mar savar: ashshabbat ippekud, attechumin la ippekud. umar savar: attechumin name ippekud.

Ta shema: nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim, bearbaa asar shachatu pischehem, uvachamishsha asar yatzu, velaerev laku bechorot. laerev salka datach?! ella: mibbaerev laku bechorot, veoto hayyom chamishi bashshabbat haya. middachamesar benisan chamsha beshabba, resh yarcha deiyyayr shabbeta, veresh yarcha desivan chad beshabbat, kashya lerabbanan!

Amri lach rabbanan: iyyayr dehahi shatta abbore abberu. ta shema dela abberu nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim: bearbaa asar shachatu pischehem, bachamishsha asar yatzu, velaerev laku bechorot. laerev salka datach?! ella ema: mibbaerev laku bechorot. veoto hayyom chamishi bashshabbat haya. hishlim nisan veera iyyayr lihyot bashshabbat.
Chasar iyyayr, veera sivan lihyot beechad bashshabbat — kashya lerabbanan! ha manni — rabbi yose hi.

Amar rav pappa, ta shema: "vayyisu meelim vayyavou kol adat bene yisrael vegomer bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashsheni". veoto hayyom shabbat haya, dichtiv: "uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai", uchetiv: "sheshet yamim tilketuhu". umiddachamesar beiyyayr shabbeta, resh yarcha desivan chad beshabba, kashya lerabbanan! amri lach rabbanan: iyyayr dehahi shatta abbore abberu.

Amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe, ta shema: "vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan" — tana, oto yom natal eser atarot: rishon lemaase vereshit; rishon lannesiim; rishon lakkehunna; rishon laavoda; rishon liridat haesh; rishon laachilat kadashim; rishon lishkon shechina; rishon levarech et yisrael; rishon leissur habbamot; rishon lechodashim. umidderesh yarcha denisan deha shatta chad beshabba — deeshtakad bearbea.

Detanya, acherim omrim: en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad, veim hayta shana meubberet — chamishsha. hava leh resh yarcha deiyyayr maale shabbeta, veresh yarcha desivan shabbeta, kashya ben lerabbi yose ben lerabbanan! lerabbi yose shiva chaserin avud,

a: Lerabbanan shemona chaserim avud.

Ta shema, detanya beseder olam": nisan shebbo yatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim bearbaa asar shachatu pischehen, bachamishsha asar yatzu, veoto hayyom erev shabbat haya. umidderesh yarcha denisan erev shabbat — resh yarcha deiyyayr chad beshabba, vesivan bitre beshabba, kashya lerabbi yose! amar lach rabbi yose: ha manni — rabbanan hi.

Ta shema, rabbi yose omer: bashsheni ala moshe veyarad, bashshelishi ala veyarad, birvii yarad veshuv lo ala. umeachar shello ala, mehechan yarad? ella: barvii ala veyarad, bachamishi bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, bashshishshi lo haya lo penay. may lav, mishshum tora?
La, mishshum torach shabbat. derash hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda: berich rachamana dihav oryan telitay, leam telitay, al yede telitay, beyom telitay, beyarcha telitay. keman — kerabbanan.

"Vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar", amar rav avdimi bar chama bar chassa: melammed shekkafa hakkadosh baruch hu alehem et hahar kegigit, veamar lahem: im attem mekabbelim hattora mutav, veim lav — sham tehe kevuratchem. amar rav acha bar yaakov: mikkan modaa rabba leorayyta. amar rava: af al pi chen hadur kabbeluha bime achashverosh, dichtiv: "kiyyemu vekibbelu hayyehudim" — kiyyeymu ma shekkibbelu kevar.

Amar chizkiyya, may dichtiv: "mishshamayim hishmata din eretz yara veshakata", im yara — lamma shakta? veim shakta — lamma yara? ella battechilla yara ulevassof shakta. velamma yara? kidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish, may dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom hashshishshi", Adonai yetera lamma li? — melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit veamar lahem: im yisrael mekabbelim hattora — attem mitkayyeymin, veim lav — ani machazir etchem letohu vavohu.

Darash rabbi simay: beshaa shehikdimu yisrael "naase" lenishma" bau shishshim ribbo shel malache hashsharet, lechol echad veechad miyyisrael kashru lo shene chetarim, echad keneged "naase" veechad keneged "nishma". vechevan shechatu yisrael, yardu mea veesrim ribbo malache chabbala uferkum, shenneemar: "vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: bechorev taanu, bechorev perku. bechorev taanu — kedaamaran, bechorev perku — dichtiv: "vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael vegomer". amar rabbi yochanan: vechullan zacha moshe unetalan. dismich leh: "umoshe yikkach et haohel". amar resh lakish: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran lanu, shenneemar: "ufeduye Adonai yeshuvun uvau tziyyon berinna vesimchat olam al rosham" — simcha shemmeolam al rosham.

Amar rabbi elazar: beshaa shehikdimu yisrael "naase" lenishma" yatzta bat kol veamra lahen: mi gilla levanay raz ze shemmalache hashsharet mishtammeshin bo? dichtiv: "barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro" — beresha "ose", vahadar "lishmoa". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer" — lamma nimshelu yisrael letappuach, lomar lach: ma tappuach ze piryo kodem lealav, af yisrael hikdimu "naase" lenishma".

Hahu mina dechazyeh lerava deka meayyen bishmata, veyatva etzbeata dideh tute kara veka mayetz behu, veka mabbean etzbeateh dema. amar leh: amma peziza, dekaddemitu pummayychu leudenayychu, akkatti befachzutayychu kayymitu. beresha ibbaya lechu lemishma, i matzitu — kabbelitu, vei la — la kabbelitu. amar leh: anan
b: Desagenan bishlimuta ketiv ban: "tummat yesharim tanchem", hanach inashe desagan baaliluta ketiv behu: "veselef bogdim yeshaddem".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "libbavtini achoti challa libbavtini beachat meenayich" — battechilla beachat meenayich, lichshettaasi — bishte enecha. amar ulla: aluva kalla mezanna betoch chuppatah. amar rav mari bera devat shemuel, may kera: "ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi vegomer". amar rav: vaadayin chabbivuta hi gabban, dichtiv "natan", vela ketiv "hisriach". tanu rabbanan: aluvin veenan olvin, shomin cherpatan veenan meshivin, osin meahava usemechin beyissurin — alehen hakkatuv omer: "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato".

Amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "Adonai yitten omer hamevasserot tzava rav" — kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi haggevura nechelak leshivim leshonot. tane deve rabbi yishmael: "uchefattish yefotzetz sala", ma pattish ze nechelak lechamma nitzotzot — af kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu nechelak leshivim leshonot. amar rav chananel bar pappa: may dichtiv "shimu ki negidim adabber" — lamma nimshelu divre tora kenagid, lomar lach: ma nagid ze yesh bo lehamit ulehachayot, af divre tora yesh bam lehamit ulehachayot.

Hayeynu deamar rava: lammayyminin bah samma dechayye, lemasmeilim bah samma demota. davar acher: "negidim" — kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu koshrim lo shene chetarim. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv: "tzeror hammor dodi li ben shaday yalin" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam af al pi shemmetzer umemer li dodi — "ben shaday yalin". "eshkol hakkofer dodi li becharme en gedi" — mi shehakkol shello mechapper li al avon gedi shekkaramti li. may mashma dehay "karme" lishshana demichnash hu? amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman, keditnan: kisse shel koves shekkormim alav et hakkelim.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, may dichtiv: "lechayav kaarugat habbosem" — kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu nitmalle kol haolam kullo besamim. vechevan shemmiddibbur rishon nitmalle, dibbur sheni lehechan halach? hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu haruach meotzrotav vehaya maavir rishon rishon, shenneemar: "siftotav shoshannim notfot mor over". (al tikre "shoshannim", ella "sheshshonim").

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu yatzta nishmatan shel yisrael, shenneemar: "nafshi yatza vedabbero". umeachar shemmiddibbur rishon yatzta nishmatan, dibbur sheni heach kibbelu? — horid tal sheatid lehachayot bo metim vehechya otam, shenneemar: "geshem nedavot tanif elohim nachalatcha venila atta chonantah". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu chazru yisrael laachorehen shenem asar mil vehayu malache hashsharet medaddin otan, shenneemar: "malache tzevaot yiddodun yiddodun" — al tikre "yiddodun", ella "yedaddun".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beshaa sheala moshe lammarom amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ma lilud ishsha benenu? amar lahen: lekabbel tora ba. amru lefanav: chemda genuza sheggenuza lach tesha meot veshivim vearbaa dorot kodem shennivra haolam, atta mevakkesh littenah levasar vadam? "ma enosh ki tizkerennu uven adam ki tifkedennu"? "Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim"!

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hachezer lahen teshuva. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mityayre ani shemma yisrefuni bahevel shebbefihem. amar lo: echoz bechisse chevodi vachazor lahen teshuva. shenneemar: "meachez pene kisse parshez alav anano", veamar rabbi nachum: melammed shepperas shadday mizziv shechinato vaanano alav. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, tora sheatta noten li ma ketiv bah? "anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim". amar lahen: lemitzrayim yeradtem? lefaro hishtabadtem? tora lamma tehe lachem! shuv: ma ketiv bah? "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim". ben haggoyim attem sheruyin, sheovdin

a: Avoda zara? shuv: ma ketiv bah? "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" — kelum attem osim melacha, sheattem tzerichin shevut? shuv: ma ketiv bah? "lo tissa" — massa umattan yesh benechem? shuv: ma ketiv bah? "kabbed et avicha veet immecha" — av vaem yesh lachem? shuv: ma ketiv bah? "lo tirtzach", "lo tinaf", "lo tignov". kina yesh benechem? yetzer hara yesh benechem? miyyad hodu lo lehakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha vegomer", veillu "tena hodcha al hashshamayim" la ketiv.

Miyyad kol echad veechad naasa lo ohev umasar lo davar, shenneemar: "alita lammarom shavita shevi lakachta mattanot baadam" — bischar shekkerauch "adam", lakachta mattanot. af malach hammavet masar lo davar, shenneemar: "vayyitten et hakketoret vaychapper al haam", veomer: "vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vegomer" — i lav daamar leh mi hava yada?

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beshaa sheyyarad moshe millifne hakkadosh baruch hu, ba satan veamar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, tora hechan hi? amar lo: netattiha laaretz. halach etzel eretz, amar lah: tora hechan hi? amra lo: "elohim hevin darkah vegomer". halach etzel yam, veamar lo: "en immadi". halach etzel tehom, amar lo: "en bi". shenneemar: "tehom amar lo vi hi veyam amar en immadi", "avaddon vamavet amru beoznenu shamanu shimah". chazar veamar lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, chippasti bechol haaretz velo metzatiha. amar lo: lech etzel ben amram.

Halach etzel moshe amar lo: tora shennatan lecha hakkadosh baruch hu hechan hi? amar lo: vechi ma ani shennatan li hakkadosh baruch hu tora? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, badday atta?! amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, chemvda genuza yesh lecha sheatta mishtaashea bah bechol yom, ani achzik tova leatzmi? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hoil umiatta atzmecha tikkare al shimcha, shenneemar: "zichru torat moshe avdi vegomer".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beshaa sheala moshe lammarom metzao lehakkadosh baruch hu shehaya kosher ketarim laotiyyot. amar lo: moshe, en shalom beircha? amar lefanav: kelum yesh eved shennoten shalom lerabbo? amar lo: haya lecha leozreni, miyyad amar lo: "veatta yigdal na koach Adonai kaasher dibbarta".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv: "vayyar haam ki voshesh moshe" — al tikre "boshesh", ella "bau shesh". beshaa sheala moshe lammarom amar lahen leyisrael: lesof arbaim yom bitchillat shesh ani ba. lesof arbaim yom ba satan veirbev et haolam. amar lahen: moshe rabbechem hechan hu? amru lo: ala lammarom. amar lahen: bau shesh, velo hishgichu alav. met, velo hishgichu alav. hera lahen demut mittato, vehayeynu dekaamri leh leaharon: "ki ze moshe haish vegomer".

Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerav kahana: mi shemia lach may "har sinay"? amar leh: har shennaasu bo nissim leyisrael. "har nissay" mibbee leh! ella: har shennaasa siman tov leyisrael. "har simanay" mibbee leh! amar leh: may tama la shechichat kammeh derav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua dimayyeyni beaggadta? derav chisda verabba bereh derav huna deamri tarvavyyhu: may "har sinay"? har sheyyarda sina leummot haolam alav. vehayeynu deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: chamishsha shemot yesh lo: midbar tzin — shennitztauu yisrael alav; midbar kadesh — shennitkaddeshu yisrael alav; midbar kedemot — shennittena keduma alav; midbar paran —
b: Shepparu veravu yisrael alav; midbar sinay — sheyyarda sina leummot haolam alav. uma shemo? "chorev" shemo. ufeliga derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: "har sinay" shemo. velamma nikra "har chorev" — sheyyarda chorba leummot haolam alav.

Minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit vechulei. "kashshanim"? "kashshani" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yitzchak, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: im yihyu chataechem kashshanim hallalu shessedurot uvaot mishsheshet yeme bereshit vead achshav — kashsheleg yalbinu. daresh rava, may dichtiv: "lechu na venivvachcha yomar Adonai" — "lechu na"? "bou na" mibbee leh! "yomar Adonai"? "amar Adonai" mibbee leh! leatid lavo yomar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: lechu na etzel avotechem veyochichu etchem.

Veyomru lefanav: ribbono shel olam etzel mi nelech? etzel avraham sheamarta lo "yadoa teda" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel yitzchak shebberach et esav "vehaya kaasher tarid" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel yaakov sheamarta lo "anochi ered immecha mitzrayma" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel mi nelech? achshav "yomar Adonai". amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: hoil utelitem atzmechem bi — "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv: "ki atta avinu ki avraham lo yedaanu veyisrael lo yakkiranu atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemecha" — leatid lavo yomar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham: banecha chatu li. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yimmachu al kedushshat shemecha. amar: emar leh leyaakov dahava leh tzaar giddul banim, efshar devae rachame alayyhu. amar leh: banecha chatu. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yimmachu al kedushshat shemecha. amar la besave tama vela bedardakke etza. omer lo leyitzchak: banecha chatu li. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, banay velo banecha?! beshaa shehikdimu lefanecha "naase" lenishma" karata lahem "beni vechori", achshav banay velo banecha?!

Veod, kamma chatu? kamma shenotav shel adam — shivim shana. dal esrin dela anshat alayyhu — pashu lehu chamshin. dal esrin vechamsha delelavata — pashu lehu esrin vechamsha. dal tarte sere ufalga detzalloye umechal udevet hakkisse — pashu lehu tarte sere ufalga, im atta sovel et kullam — mutav, veim lav — palga alay ufalga alaych. veim timtza lomar kullam alay — ha karevit nafshi kammach. potchin veomrin: "ki atta avinu". omer lahem yitzchak: ad sheattem mekallesin li, kallesu lehakkadosh baruch hu, umachve lehu yitzchak lekudesha berich hu beeneh. miyyad nosim enehem lammarom veomrim: "atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemecha".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: rauy haya yaakov avinu lered lemitzrayim beshalshelaot shel barzel, ella shezzechuto garma lo, dichtiv: "bechavle adam emshechem baavotot ahava vaehye lahem kimrime ol al lechehem veat elav ochil".

Mishna hammotzi etzim — kede levashshel betza kalla. tavlin — kede letabbel betza kalla. umitztarfin ze im ze. kelippe egozin, kelippe rimmonim, estes ufua — kede litzboa bahen beged katan pi sevacha. me raglayim, neter uvorit, kimolya veashlag — kede lechabbes beged katan pi sevacha, rabbi yehuda omer: kede lehaavir et hakketem.

Gemara tenena chada zimna! kane — kede laasot kulemos, im haya av o merussas — kede levashshel betza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna bailpas. mahu detema: hatam hu dela chaze lemidde, aval etzim dachazu lechakka deaklida afillu kol shehu, ka mashma lan.
Tavlin kede letabbel betza kalla. ureminhu: tavlin, shenayim ushelosha shemot mimmin echad, o mishshelosha minin veshem echad — asurin, umitztarfin ze im ze. veamar chizkiyya:

a: Bemine metika shanu, hoil ureuyin lemattek kedera. tama dachazu lemattek et hakkedera, ha lav hachi — la! hacha name chazu lemattek.

Kelippe egozin ukelippe rimmonim setes ufua — kede litzboa beged katan. ureminhi: hammotzi sammanim sheruyin — kede litzboa bahen dugema leira! ha ittemar ala, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lefi sheen adam toreach lishrot sammanim litzboa bahen dugema leira.
Me raglayim. tana: me raglayim ad ben arbaim yom. neter. tana: neter alekkesanderit, velo neter anpanterin. borit. amar rav yehuda: ze chol. vehatanya: habborit vehachol! ella: may borit — kavrita.

Metivi, hosifu alehen hachalbetzin vehalleinin vehabborit vehaahal. vei salka datach kavrita, kavrita mi ita bishviit?! vehatnan: ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh lo ikkar — yesh lo sheviit, vesheen lo ikkar — en lo sheviit! ella may borit — ahala. vehatanya: borit veahala! ella tere gavvne ahala.
Kimolya, amar rav yehuda: shelof dotz. ashlag, amar shemuel: sheeltinhu lechol nachote yamma, vaamaru li "shunaga" shemeh, umishtechach benukeba demarganita, umappeki leh berimtza defarzela.

Mishna pilpelet — kol shehu, veitran — kol shehu. mine vesamim umine mattachot — kol shehen. meavne hammizbeach umeafar hammizbeach, mekak sefarim umekak mitpechotehem — kol shehu, shemmatzniin otan legonzan. rabbi yehuda omer: af hammotzi meshammeshe avoda zara — kol shehu, shenneemar: "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem".

Gemara pilpelet kol shehu lemay chazya? lereach happe. itran kol shehu lemay chaze? letzilchata. mine besamim — kol shehen. tanu rabbanan: hammotzi reach ra — kol shehu. shemen tov — kol shehu. argaman — kol shehu. uvetulat havvevred — achat.
Mine mattachot — kol shehen. lemay chazu? tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: shekken rauy laasot mimmenna dorvan katan.

Tanu rabbanan: haomer "hare alay barzel", acherim omrim: lo yifchot meamma al amma. lemay chazya? amar rav yosef: lechalyay orev. veikka deamri, acherim omrim: lo yifchot mikkalyay orev. vechamma? amar rav yosef: amma al amma. nechoshet, lo yifchot mimmaa kesef. tanya rabbi eliezer omer: lo yifchot mitztzinnora ketanna shel nechoshet. lemay chazya? amar abbaye: shemmechattetin bah et happetilot umekannechin hannerot.

Mekak sefarim umekak mitpachot. amar rabbi yehuda: mekak desifre, techach deshirae, veayla deinve, ufah ditene, vehah derimmone — kullehu sakkanta. hahu talmida dahava yatev kammeh derabbi yochanan, hava kaachel teene. amar leh: rabbi, kotzin yesh batteenim? amar (leh): katleh pah leden.
Mishna hammotzi kuppat harochlin, af al pi sheyyesh bah minin harebe — eno chayyayv ella chattat achat. zerone ginna — pachot mikkigrogeret. rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: chamishsha.
b: Zera kishshuin — shenayim. zera dilluin — shenayim. zera pol hammitzri — shenayim. chagav chay tahor — kol shehu. met — kigrogeret. tzipporet keramim, ben chayya ben meta — kol shehu, shemmatzniin otah lirfua. rabbi yehuda omer: af hammotzi chagav chay tame kol shehu, shemmatzniin oto lekatan lischok bo.

Gemara ureminhi: zevel vachol haddak — kede lezabbel kelach shel keruv, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: kede lezabbel keresha! amar rav pappa: ha dizria, ha dela zeria — lefi sheen adam toreach lehotzi nima achat lizria.

Zera kishshuin. tanu rabbanan: hammotzi garinin, im lintia — shetayim, im laachila — kimlo pi chazir, vechamma melo pi chazir — achat. im lehassik — kede levashshel betza kalla. im lecheshbon — shetayim. acherim omrim: chamesh. tanu rabbanan: hammotzi shene nimin mizzenav hassus umizzenav happara — chayyayv, shemmatzniin otan lenishbin. mikshe shel chazir — achat. tzure dekel — shetayim. tore dekel — achat.

Tzipporet keramim, ben chayya ben meta — kol shehu. may tzipporet keramim? amar rav: palya biari. amar abbaye: umishtachcha bedikla dechad nevara veavdi la lechuchema. achel leh lefalga deyammineh, ufalga dismaleh rame le beguveta dinchasha vechatem le beshittin gushepanke, vetale le beivra dismala. vesimanaych: "lev chacham limino velev kesil lismolo", vechachem kamma devae, vegamar kamma devae, veachel leh leiddach palga, dei la — miakar talmudeh.

Rabbi yehuda omer af hammotzi kulei. vetanna kamma savar la. may tama? dilma achel leh: i hachi, tahor name. deha rav kahana hava kaem kammeh derav, vahava kamabbar shoshiva appummeh. amar leh: shikleh, dela lemru mechal kaachel leh, vekaavar mishshum "bal teshakketzu et nafshotechem"! ella, dilma mayet veachel leh. verabbi yehuda i mayet — katan mispad safed leh.
Haderan alach amar rabbi akiva
Mishna hammatznia lezera uledugema velirfua vehotzio beshabbat — chayyayv bechol shehu. vechol adam — en chayyayv alav ella keshiuro. chazar vehichniso — eno chayyayv ella keshiuro.

Gemara lema leh lemitne "hammatznia"? litne: hammotzi lezera uledugema velirfua — chayyayv bechol shehu! amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shehitznio veshachach lamma hitznio, vehasheta ka mappek leh setama.

a: Mahu detema, battole battela lemachshavto — ka mashma lan: kol haose, al daat rishona hu ose.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mechayyev haya rabbi meir af bemotzi chitta achat lizria. peshita, "kol shehu" tenan! mahu detema: "kol shehu" — leappoke miggerogeret, uleolam ad deikka kezayit, ka mashma lan. matkif la rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: ella meatta, chishshev lehotzi kol beto, hachi name dela michayyayv ad demappek lechulleh?! hatam — batla dato etzel kol adam.

Vechol adam en chayyayvin alav ella keshiuro. matnitin dela kerabbi shimon ben elazar, detanya: kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar, kol sheeno kasher lehatzenia, veen matzniin kamohu, vehucheshar laze vehitznio, uva acher vehotzio — nitchayyev ze bemachshavto shel ze.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: hotzi kigrogeret laachila, venimlach aleha lizria, i name lizria, venimlach aleha laachila — chayyayv. peshita, zil hacha — ikka shiura, vezil hacha — ikka shiura! mahu detema baenan akira vehannacha bachada machshava veha lekka — ka mashma lan.

Bae rava: hotzi chatzi gerogeret lizria vetafcha, venimlach aleha laachila, mahu? im timtze lomar: hatam hu demichayyayv — dezil hacha ikka shiura vezil hacha ikka shiura, hacha, kevan dividdana deappeke la hava beh shiur achila — la michayyayv, o dilma: kevan deillu ishtik vela chashshev aleh michayyayv ammachshava dizria — hasheta name michayyayv.

Veim timtze lomar: kevan deillu ishtik vela chashshev aleh michayyayv ammachshava dizria, hasheta name michayyayv — hotzi kigrogeret laachila vetzamka venimlach aleha lizria, mahu? hacha vadday ki ishtik — ammachshava kammayyta la michayyayv, o dilma batar hasheta azlinan, umichayyayv. veim timtze lomar: batar hasheta azlinan, umichayyayv — hotzi kigrogeret laachila vetzamka vechazra vetafcha, mahu? yesh dichuy leinyan shabbat, o en dichuy leinyan shabbat? teku.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: zarak kezayit teruma levayit tame mahu? lemay: i leinyan shabbat — kigrogeret baenan, i leinyan tumea — kevetza ochalin baenan! leolam leinyan shabbat, uchegon deikka pachot mikkevetza ochalin, vehay mashlimo lichvetza. may: middemitztaref leinyan tumea — michayyayv name leinyan shabbat, o dilma: kol leinyan shabbat kigrogeret baenan? amar leh: tenetuha. abba shaul omer: shete hallechem velechem happanim shiuran kigrogeret, veammay? lema: middilinyan
b: Yotze — bichzayit, leinyan shabbat name — bichzayit! hachi hasheta?! hatam — middeappekeh chutz lechomat haazara ippesil leh beyotze, ashshabbat la michayyayv ad demappek leh lirshut harabbim, hacha — shabbat vetumea bahade hadade kaatyayn.

Chazar vehichniso eno chayyayv ella keshiuro. peshita! amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shezzerako leotzar umekomo nikkar. mahu detema: kevan dimkomo nikkar bemilleteh kammayyta kae, ka mashma lan — middezarkeh leotzar, battole batteleh.

Mishna hammotzi ochalin unetanan al haaskuppa, ben shechazar vehotzian, ben shehotzian acher — patur, mippene shello asa melachto bevat achat. kuppa shehi melea perot unetanah al askuppa hachitzona, af al pi sherov perot mibbachutz — patur, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa.

Gemara hay askuppa, may? ilema askuppa reshut harabbim — patur? ha ka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim! ella askuppa reshut hayyachid. ben shechazar vehotzian, ben shehotzian acher — patur? ha ka mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim!

Ella askuppa karmelit, veha ka mashma lan: tama denach becharmelit, ha la nach becharmelit — michayyayv. matnitin dela keven azzay. detanya: hammotzi mechanut liflatya derech setav — chayyayv, uven azzay poter.

Kuppa shehi melea kulei. amar chizkiyya: lo shanu ella bekuppa melea kishshuin vedilluin, aval melea chardal — chayyayv. alma kasavar eged keli — la shemeh eged. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu melea chardal — patur. alma kasavar eged keli — shemeh eged.

Amar rabbi zera: matnitin dela kechizkiyya dayka, udela kerabbi yochanan dayka: kechizkiyya la dayka — dekatane: "ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa" — tama dechol hakkuppa, ha kol happerot — patur, alma kasavar eged keli shemeh eged. kerabbi yochanan la dayka — dekatane: "af al pi sherov perot bachutz" — tama derov perot, ha kol perot, af al gav daagida kuppa miggavvay — chayyayv, alma kasavar eged keli la shemeh eged.

Veella kashya! chizkiyya metaretz letameh, verabbi yochanan metaretz letameh. chizkiyya metaretz letameh: "ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa", bamme devarim amurim — bekuppa melea kishshuin vedilluin, aval melea chardal — naase kemi shehotzi et kol hakkuppa, vechayyayv. rabbi yochanan metaretz letameh, "af al pi sherov perot bachutz", velo rov perot bilvad, ella afillu kol perot — patur, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa.

Metivi: hammotzi kuppat harochlin unetanah al askuppa hachitzona, af al pi sherov minin bachutz — patur, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa. ka salka datach bitzrare, kashya lechizkiyya! amar lach chizkiyya: hacha bemay askinan — beurenase.

Metiv rav bivi bar abbaye: haggonev kis beshabbat — chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat. haya megarer veyotze — patur, shehare issur geneva veissur shabbat bain keechad. vei salka datach eged keli — shemeh eged, kadem leh issur geneva leissur shabbat!
I deappekeh derech piv — hachi name. hacha bemay askinan? — deappekeh derech shulav. vehaikka mekom chalama,

a: Dei bae mefakka leh veshakel! beniska. vechevan deikka shenatzin, mappek leh ad pummeh veshare veshakel, ushenatzin agidi miggavvay! delekka shenatzin. veibbaet ema deit leh, umecharchi illaveh.

Vechen amar rava: lo shanu ella bekuppa melea kishshuin vedilluin, aval melea chardal — chayyayv. alma kasavar eged keli la shemeh eged. abbaye amar: afillu melea chardal — patur, alma kasavar eged keli shemeh eged. kam abbaye beshitteh derava, kam rava beshitteh deabbaye, verame deabbaye addeabbaye, verame derava adderava.
Deittemar: hammotzi perot lirshut harabbim, abbaye amar: bayyad — chayyayv, bichli — patur. verava amar: bayyad — patur, bichli — chayyayv!

Efoch: bayyad — chayyayv. vehatnan: pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz, venatal heani mittochah o shennatan letochah vehichnis — shenehen peturin. hatam — lemala mishshelosha, hacha — lematta mishshelosha.

Mishna hammotzi, ben bimino ben bismolo, betoch cheko o al ketefav — chayyayv, shekken massa bene kehat. kilachar yado, beraglo, befiv uvemarpeko, beozno uvisaro, uvefunedato ufiha lematta, ben punedato lachaluko, uvisfat chaluko, beminalo, besandalo — patur, shello hotzi kederech hammotziin.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar: hammotzi massooy lemala measara tefachim — chayyayv, shekken massa bene kehat. umassa bene kehat menalan? dichtiv: "al hammishkan veal hammizbeach saviv" — makkish mizbeach lemishkan: ma mishkan eser ammot, af mizbeach eser ammot.

Umishkan gufeh menalan? dichtiv: "eser ammot orech hakkaresh", uchetiv: "vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan", veamar rav: moshe rabbenu peraso. mikkan atta lamed govhan shel leviyyim eser ammot. ugemiri dechol tuna demiddele bemotot — tilta milleel utere tilte milletachat, ishtechach dahava middele tuva.

Veibbaet ema: mearon. deamar mar: aron tisha vechapporet tefach. hare kan asara, ugemiri dechol tuna demiddele bemotot — tilta milleel utere tilte millera, ishtechach demillemala measara hava kae. veligmar mimmoshe? dilma moshe shane, deamar mar: en hashshechina shora ella al chacham gibbor veashir uvaal koma.

Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: hammotzi massooy beshabbat al rosho — chayyayv chattat, shekken anshe hutzal osin ken. veanshe hutzal rubba dealma?! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: echad mibbene hutzal shehotzi massoy al rosho beshabbat — chayyayv, shekken bene iro osin ken. vetivtal dato etzel kol adam! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: hammotzi massoy al rosho — patur,
b: Veim timtza lomar anshe hutzal osin ken — batla datan etzel kol adam.

Mishna hammitkavven lehotzi lefanav, uva lo leacharav — patur. leacharav uva lo lefanav — chayyayv. beemet amru: haishsha hachogeret besinar, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha — chayyevet, shekken rauy lihyot chozer. rabbi yehuda omer: af mekabbele fitkin.

Gemara may shena lefanav uva lo leacharav defatur — dela itavida machshavto, leacharav uva lo lefanav name, ha la itavida machshavto! amar rabbi elazar: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma: lefanav uva lo leacharav hayeynu tama defatur — denitkavvevn lishmira meulla vealta beyado shemira pechuta, leacharav uva lo lefanav hayeynu tama dechayyayv — denitkavvevn lishmira pechuta vealta beyado shemira meulla.

Ella may kusheya — diyyuka dematnitin kashya: hammitkavven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav — patur, ha leacharav uva lo leacharav — chayyayv. ema sefa: leacharav uva lo lefanav hu dechayyayv, ha leacharav uva lo leacharav patur! amar rabbi elazar: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.

Amar rav ashe: may kusheya? dilma la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya leacharav uva lo leacharav dechayyayv — deitavida machshavto, ella afillu leacharav uva lo lefanav itztericha leh. salka datach amena, hoil vela itavida machshavto la lichayyayv — ka mashma lan denitkavvevn lishmira pechuta vealta beyado shemira meulla dechayyayv.

Uleacharav uva lo leacharav tannae hi. detanya: hammotzi maot befunedato ufiha lemala — chayyayv. piha lematta — rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. amar lahen rabbi yehuda: i attem modim bilacharav uva lo leacharav shehu chayyayv? veamru lo: vei atta mode kilachar yado veraglo shehu patur?

Amar rabbi yehuda: ani amarti davar echad vehen amru davar echad. ani lo matzati teshuva ledivrehem vehen lo matzu teshuva lidvaray. middekaamar lehu "i attem modin" — lav mikkelal defatri rabbanan? velitamaych, dekaamri leh "i atta mode" — mikkelal dimchayyev rabbi yehuda? vehatanya: leachar yado veraglo divre hakkol patur!

Ella: leacharav uva lo leacharav, divre hakkol chayyayv. leachar yado veraglo, divre hakkol patur. ki peligi, befunedato ufiha lematta: mar medamme leh leacharav uva lo leacharav, umar medamme leh leachar yado veraglo.
Beemet amru haishsha kulei. [tana kol "beemet" — halacha hi. rabbi yehuda omer af mekabbele fitkin.] tana: shekken lavlare malchut osin ken.
Mishna hammotzi kikkar lirshut harabbim — chayyayv. hotziuhu shenayim — peturin. lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim — chayyayvin. verabbi shimon poter.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la amar abbaye, veamri la bematnita tana: ze yachol veze yachol — rabbi meir mechayyev, verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon potrim. ze eno yachol veze eno yachol — rabbi yehuda verabbi meir mechayyeyvim verabbi shimon poter. ze yachol veze eno yachol — divre hakkol chayyayv.

Tanya name hachi: hammotzi kikkar lirshut harabbim — chayyayv. hotziuhu shenayim — rabbi meir mechayyev, verabbi yehuda omer: im lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim — chayyayvin, veim lav — peturim, verabbi shimon poter. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "baasotah" — haose et kullah velo haose et miktzatah, ketzad? shenayim shehayu ochazin bemalgez velogzin, becharker veshovtin, bekulemos vechotvin, bekane vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim, yachol yehu chayyayvin — talmud lomar: "baasotah" — haose et kullah velo haose miktzatah.

a: Beiggul shel devela vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim, bekora vehotziuha lirshut harabbim, rabbi yehuda omer: im lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim — chayyayvin, veim lav — peturin. rabbi shimon omer: af al pi shello yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim — peturim, lechach neemar "baasotah" — yachid sheasaah chayyayv, shenayim sheasauha — peturin.

Bemay kamippalgi? behay kera: "veim nefesh achat techeta vishgaga meam haaretz baasotah". rabbi shimon savar: telata miute ketivi, "nefesh techta", "achat techta", "baasotah techta" — chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach, vechad lemaote ze yachol veze yachol, vechad lemaote ze eno yachol veze eno yachol.
Verabbi yehuda: chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach, vechad lemaote ze yachol veze yachol, vechad lemaote yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din. verabbi shimon: yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din — chayyayv.
Verabbi meir — mi ketiv "nefesh techta" "achat techta" "baasotah techta"? tere miute ketivi, chad lemaote ze oker veze manniach, vechad lemaote yachid sheasaah behoraat bet din.

Amar mar: ze yachol veze eno yachol — divre hakkol chayyayv. he minnayyhu michayyayv? amar rav chisda: ze sheyyachol, dei ze sheeno yachol — may ka aved! amar leh rav hamenuna: deka mesayyay bahadeh! amar leh: mesayyea en bo mammash.

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava, af anan name tenena: haya yoshev al gabbe hammitta, vearba talliyyot tachat ragle hammitta — temeot, mippene sheenah yechola laamod al shalosh, verabbi shimon metaher. haya rochev al gabbe behema vearba talliyyot tachat ragle habbehema — tehorot, mippene sheyyechola laamod al shalosh. veammay? ha kamsayyaya bahade hadade! lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash?

Amar rav yehuda middiskarta: leolam ema lach mesayyea yesh bo mammash, veshane hacha deakra la ligmare. vechevan dezimnin akra ha, vezimnin akra ha, leheve kezav hammithappech! mi la tenan: zav shehaya muttal al chamishsha safsalin o al chamesh punedaot, leorkan — temeim, lerochban — tehorin. yashen, safek mithappech alehen — temein.
Ella lav, mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash. amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: af anan name tenena,
b: Rabbi yose omer: hassus metamme al yadav, hachamor — al raglav, shemmishenet hassus al yadav, vachamor al raglav. veammay? ha ka mesayyay bahade hadade! lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash? amar rav ashe: af anan name tenena. rabbi eliezer omer: raglo achat al hakkeli veraglo achat al haritzpa, raglo achat al haeven veraglo achat al haritzpa — roin kol sheillu yinnatel hakkeli vetinnatel haeven yachol laamod al raglo achat — avodato keshera, veim lav — avodato pesula.

Veammay? ha ka mesayyay bahade hadade! lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash. amar ravina: af anan name tenena. kibbel beyamin, usemol mesayyayto — avodato keshera. veammay, ha ka mesayyay bahade hadade! lav mishshum deamrinan mesayyea en bo mammash? shema minna.

Amar mar: ze yachol veze yachol, rabbi meir mechayyayv. ibbaya lehu: baenan shiur laze veshiur laze, o dilma shiur echad lechullam. rav chisda verav hamenuna, chad amar shiur laze veshiur laze, vechad amar shiur echad lechullan. amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: af anan name tenena: haya yoshev al gabbe mitta vearba talliyyot tachat arba ragle hammitta — temeot, mippene sheen yechola laamod al shalosh. veammay? live shiur ziva laze veshiur ziva laze! lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullan.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena: tzevi shennichnas labbayit, venaal echad befanav — chayyayv. naalu shenayim — peturin. lo yachol echad linol, venaalu shenayim — chayyayvim. veammay? live shiur tzeda laze veshiur tzeda laze! lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam? amar ravina: af anan name tenena: hashshuttafin shegganvu vetavchu — chayyayvin. veammay? live shiur tevicha laze veshiur tevicha laze! lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam?

Veamar rav ashe: af anan name tenena: shenayim shehotziu kane shel gardi — chayyayvin. veammay? live shiur hotzaa laze veshiur hotzaa laze! lav mishshum deamrinan shiur echad lechullam? amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: dilma deit beh kede levashshel betza kalla laze uvetza kalla laze! im ken, layshmeinan kane dealma, may shena degardi? vedilma deit beh kede leerog mappa laze uchede leerog mappa laze, ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: shenayim shehotziu kane shel gardi — peturin, verabbi shimon mechayyev. kelappe leyay?! ella ema: chayyayvin, verabbi shimon poter.

Mishna hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkeshiur bichli — patur af al hakkeli, shehakkeli tefela lo, et hachay bammitta — patur af al hammitta, shehammitta tefela lo. et hammet bammitta — chayyayv, vechen kezayit min hammet uchezayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz — chayyayv, verabbi shimon poter.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammotzi ochalin keshiur, im bichli — chayyayv al haochalin ufatur al hakkeli. veim haya keli tzarich lo — chayyayv af al hakkeli. shema minna, ochel shene zete chelev behelem echad chayyayv shetayim! amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan — kegon

a: Sheshshagag al haochalin vehezid al hakkeli. matkef la rav ashe: veha "af al hakkeli" katane! ella amar rav ashe: kegon sheshshagag baze uvaze, venoda lo, vechazar venoda lo, uviflugeta derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish.

Et hachay bammitta patur af al hammitta. lema matnitin rabbi natan hi vela rabbanan, detanya: hammotzi behema chayya vaof lirshut harabbim, ben chayyin uven shechutin — chayyayv. rabbi natan omer: al shechutin chayyayv veal chayyin patur, shehachay nose et atzmo. amar rava: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi natan ella bivhema chayya vaof dimsharbeti nafshayyhu, aval adam chay denose et atzmo — afillu rabbanan modu.

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava, veha ditnan: ben betira mattir bassus. vetanya: ben betira mattir bassus mippene shehu ose bo melacha sheen chayyayvin alav chattat, veamar rabbi yochanan: ben betira verabbi natan amru davar echad. vei amrat dela peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi natan ella bivhema chayya vaof mishshum dimsharbeti nafshayyhu, may irya ben betira verabbi natan? vehaamrat afillu rabbanan modu! ki amar rabbi yochanan, besus hameyuchad leofot. umi ikka sus hameyuchad leofot? in, ikka devi zeyayrin.

Amar rabbi yochanan: umode rabbi natan bechafut. amar leh rav adda bar matna leabbaye: veha hane parsae dichman dichfiti damu, veamar rabbi yochanan: ben betira verabbi natan amru davar echad! hatam, ramut rucha hu denaket lehu. dehahu pardashcha dirtach malka illaveh, urehat telata parse bechareh.
Et hammet bammitta chayyayv vechen kezayit min hammet vechulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, veamar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: poter haya rabbi shimon
b: Af bemotzi et hammet lekovro. amar rava: umode rabbi shimon bemar lachpor bo vesefer tora likrot bo — dechayyayv. peshita, dei ha name melacha sheenah tzericha legufah hi, ella melacha shetztzericha legufah lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachat la? mahu detema, ad deikka legufo ulegufah, kegon mar laasot lo tas velachpor, sefer tora lehaggiah velikrot bo, ka mashma lan.

Hahu shachva dahava bidrokeret, shera rav nachman bar yitzchak leappokeh lecharmelit. amar leh rabbi yochanan achu demar bereh deravna larav nachman bar yitzchak: keman, kerabbi shimon? emar defatar rabbi shimon mechiyyuv chattat, issura derabbanan miha ikka! amar leh: haelohim, deayylat beh at? vaafillu lerabbi yehuda shere, demi kaamena lirshut harabbim? lecharmelit kaamena, gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et "lo taase" shebbattora.

Tenan hatam: hattolesh simane tumea vehakkove [et] hammichya over belo taase". ittemar: achat mishshetayim chayyayv, achat mishshalosh — rav nachman amar chayyayv, rav sheshet amar patur. rav nachman amar chayyayv — ahni maasav, dei mishtakla chada achariti azla la tumea. rav sheshet amar patur — hasheta mihat ha ita letumea.

Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la — ditnan: vechen kezayit min hammet uchezayit min hannevela — chayyayv, ha chatzi zayit — patur, vehatanya: "chatzi zayit — chayyayv"! — may lav, ha detanya "chayyayv" — deappek chatzi zayit mikkezayit, veha ditnan "patur" — deappek chatzi zayit mikkezayit umechetza. verav nachman: idde veidde chayyayv, veha ditnan "patur", deappek chatzi zayit mimmet gadol.

Mishna hannotel tzippornav zo bazo, o beshinnav, vechen searo, vechen sefamo, vechen zekano, vechen haggodelet, vechen hakkochelet, vechen happokeset — rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim osrin mishshum shevut.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar: machaloket bayyad, aval bichli — chayyayv. peshita, "zo bazo" tenan! mahu detema: rabbanan bichli name patri, veha dekatane "zo bazo" — lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer, ka mashma lan.

Veamar rabbi elazar: machaloket leatzmo, aval lachavero — divre hakkol patur. peshita, "tzippornav", tenan! mahu detema rabbi eliezer lachavero name mechayyayv, veha dekatane "tzippornav" lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, ka mashma lan.
Vechen searo kulei. tana: hannotel melo fi hazzug — chayyayv. vechamma melo fi hazzug? amar rav yehuda: shetayim. vehatanya: velakkorcha shetayim! ema: vechen lakkorcha shetayim.

Tanya name hachi: hannotel melo fi hazzug beshabbat — chayyayv. vechamma melo fi hazzug — shetayim. rabbi eliezer omer: achat, umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bimlakket levanot mittoch shechorot, sheafillu achat chayyayv. vedavar ze af bachol asur, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha".
