Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: tzipporen shepperesh rubbah, vetzitzin sheppershu rubban, bayyad — muttar, bichli — chayyayv chattat. mi ikka midde devichli chayyayv chattat, uvayyad muttar lechattechilla?! hachi kaamar: pershu rubban, bayyad — muttar, bichli — patur aval asur. lo pershu rubban, bayyad — patur aval asur, bichli — chayyayv chattat. amar rav yehuda: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheppershu kelappe mala umetzaarot oto.

Vechen haggodelet kulei. godelet, kochelet ufokeset mishshum may mechayyeyva? amar rabbi avin, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: godelet — mishshum oreget, kochelet — mishshum kotevet, pokeset — mishshum tova. amaru rabbanan kammeh derabbi avahu: vechi derech ariga bechach, vechi derech ketiva bechach, vechi derech teviyya bechach?! ella amar rabbi avahu: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yose berabbi chanina,

a: Kochelet — mishshum tzovaat, godelet ufokeset — mishshum bona. vechi derech binyan bechach? in, kiddaresh rabbi shimon ben menasya: "vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela", melammed shekkilleah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva veheviah etzel adam — shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita "bannayta". tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: godelet kochelet ufokeset, leatzmah — petura, lachavertah — chayyevet. vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: ishsha lo taavir serak al paneha mippene shetztzovaat.

Tanu rabbanan: hacholev vehamechabbetz vehamegabben — kigrogeret. hamechabbed, vehamerabbetz, veharode challot devash, shagag beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, hezid beyom tov — loke arbaim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze eno ella mishshum shevut.

Rav nachman bar gureya ikkela linhardaa. beo minneh: cholev, mishshum may michayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum cholev. mechabbetz, mishshum may michayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum mechabbetz. megabben, mishshum may chayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum megabben. amaru leh: rabbach katel kene beagma hava. ata sheel be midresha. amaru leh: cholev chayyayv — mishshum mefarek. mechabbetz chayyayv — mishshum borer, megabben chayyayv — mishshum bone.

Hamechabbed, hamerabbetz, veharode challot devash, shagag beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, hezid beyom tov — loke arbaim, divre rabbi eliezer. amar rabbi elazar: may tama derabbi eliezer — dichtiv: "vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash", vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash? ella lomar lach: ma yaar, hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, af challot devash, harode mimmennu beshabbat — chayyayv chattat.

Ammemar shera zilcha bemachoza. amar: tama may amur rabbanan — dilma ate leashvoye gummot, hacha lekka gummot. rava tosfaa ashkecheh leravina deka mitztaar mehavela, veamri la mar kashshisha bereh derava ashkecheh larav ashe deka mitztaar mehavela, amar leh: la savar la mar leha detanya: harotze lerabbetz et beto beshabbat, mevi areva melea mayim verochetz panav bezavit zo, yadav bezavit zo, raglav bezavit zo, venimtza habbayit mitrabbetz meelav? amar leh: lav addatay.
Tana: ishsha chachama merabbetzet betah beshabbat. vehaiddana disvira lan kerabbi shimon, shere afillu lechattechilla.
Mishna hattolesh meatzitz nakuv — chayyayv, vesheeno nakuv — patur. verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze.

Gemara rame leh abbaye lerava, veamri la rabbi chiyyay bar rav lerav: tenan rabbi shimon poter baze uvaze. alma nakuv lerabbi shimon — kesheeno nakuv meshavve leh. ureminhu, rabbi shimon omer: en ben nakuv lesheeno nakuv
b: Ella lehacheshir zeraim bilvad! amar leh: lechol mille rabbi shimon ketalush meshavve leh, veshane leinyan tumea, dehattora ribbeta tohora etzel zeraim, shenneemar: "al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea".

Bea minneh hahu sava merabbi zera: shoresh keneged nekev ma li amar rabbi shimon? ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. zimna chada ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar: umode rabbi shimon sheim nikkav bichde tohorato. amar leh: hasheta shoresh keneged nekev beay minnach vela amart li vela midde, nikkav bichde tohorato mibbaya?!
Amar abbaye: vei ittemar leha derabbi zera, hachi hu deittemar: umode rabbi shimon sheim nikkav lematta merviit.

Amar rava, chamesh middot bichle cheres: nikkav kemotzi mashke — tahor milletamme gistera vaadayin keli hu lekaddesh bo me chattat; nikkav kechones mashke — tahor millekaddesh bo me chattat vaadayin keli hu lehacheshir bo zeraim; nikkav keshoresh katan — tahor millehachshir bo zeraim vaadayin keli hu lekabbel bo zetim; nikkav kemotzi zetim — tahor millekabbel bo zetim vaadayin keli hu lekabbel bo rimmonim; nikkav kemotzi rimmonim — tahor mikkelum. veim hukkaf tzamid patil — ad sheyyippachet rubbo.
Amar rav assi: shamati keli cheres shiuro kemotzi rimmon. amar leh rava: shemma lo shamata ella bemukkaf tzemid patil. veha rava hu deamar mukkaf tzemid patil ad sheyyippachet rubbo! la kashya,

a: Ha beravreve, veha bezutere. amar rav assi, shonin: kele cheres shiuro bechones mashke. velo amru motzi mashke ella leinyan gistera bilvad. may tama? amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: lefi, sheen omrim "have gistera legistera".

Amar ulla: peligi ba tere amorae bemareva, rabbi yose berabbi avin verabbi yose bar zavda. chad amar kemotzi rimmon, vechad amar: keshoresh katan. vesimanaych, echad hammarbe veechad hammamit. amar rav chinnana bar kahana mishshemeh derabbi eliezer: keli cheres shiuro kemotzi zetim. umar kashshisha bereh derabba mesayyem ba mishshemeh derabbi eliezer: vahare hen kichle gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama — sheen mekabbelin tumea lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim. uleinyan tzamid patil, ad sheyyifchat rubbo.
Haderan alach hammatznia

Mishna hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid — chayyayv. mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza — rabbi akiva mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Ketzad? shete gezuzetraot zo keneged zo birshut harabbim, hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lazo — patur, hayu shetehen bidyota achat — hammoshit chayyayv vehazzorek patur, shekkach hayta avodat haleviyyim.
Shete agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim, moshitin hakkerashim mizzo lazo, aval lo zorkin.
b: Gemara mikkede zerika tolada dehotzaa hi, hotzaa gufa hecha ketiva? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vaytzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane", moshe hechan hava yatev? — bemachane leviyya, umachane leviyya reshut harabbim havay, vekaamar lehu leyisrael: la tappiku vetayto mershut hayyachid didchu lirshut harabbim.
Umimmay divshabbat kae? dilma bechol kae, umishshum dishlima la melacha, kedichtiv: "vehammelacha hayta dayyam vegomer"?! — gamar "haavara" "haavara" miyyom hakkippurim:
Ketiv hacha: "vayyaaviru kol bammachane", uchetiv hatam: "vehaavarta shofar terua", ma lehallan — bayyom asur, af kan — bayyom asur.
Ashkechan hotzaa, hachenasa menalan? sevara hi: mikkede mershut lirshut hu, ma li appoke uma li ayyole! mihu, hotzaa — av, hachenasa — tolada.
Umikkede aha michayyayv veaha michayyayv, ammay kare la hay "av", veammay kare la hay "tolada"?
Nafka minna dei aved shete avot bahade hadade, i name shete toladot bahade hadade — michayyayv tarte, vei aved av vetolada dideh — la michayyayv ella chada.

Ulerabbi eliezer dimchayyev attolada bimkom av — ammay karu la "av", veammay karu la "tolada"? hach dahavay bemishkan chashiva — kare la "av", hach dela havay bammishkan chashiva — la kare la "av". i name: hach dichtiva — kare "av", vehach dela ketiva kare "tolada".
Veha ditnan: hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim — kezorek baavir. lematta measara tefachim — kezorek baaretz, vehazzorek baaretz arba ammot — chayyayv.

Zarak arba ammot birshut harabbim, menalan demichayyayv? amar rabbi yoshiyya: shekken orge yeriot zorkin machatehen ze laze. orgin, mechatin lema lehu? ella, shekken tofre yeriot zorkin machatehen ze laze.
Vedilma gabbe hadade havo yatvi?! matu hadade bemachtin. dilma betoch arba havo yatvi?
Ella amar rav chisda: shekken orge yeriot zorkin bucheyar bayyeria. vahalo ogdo beyado! — beniska batra.
Veha bimkom petur kaazla! — ella, shekken orge yeriot zorkin bucheyar leshoalehen. vedilma gabbe hadade havo yatvi?! matu hadade bechefet.
Vedilma shalchofe havo meshalchafi?! vetu, mi shayli mehadade? vehatane ludda: "ish ish mimmelachto asher hemma osim" — mimmelachto hu ose veeno ose mimmelechet chavero!
Vetu: maavir arba ammot birshut harabbim menalan demichayyayv? ella: kol arba ammot birshut harabbim gemara gemiri la.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mekoshesh, maavir arba ammot birshut harabbim hava. bematnita tana: tolesh hava. rav acha berabbi yaakov amar: meammer hava.

Lemay nafka minna? lechidrav, deamar rav: matzati megillat setarim be rabbi chiyyay vechatuv bah, isi ben yehuda omer: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat veim asaan kullan behelem achat veeno chayyayv ella achat. achat vetu la? vehatnan: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, vehavenan ba: minyayna lema li? veamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullam behelem achat — chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Ema: eno chayyayv al achat mehem.

Rav yehuda peshita leh dehammaavir chayyayv, umatnitin peshita leh detolesh chayyayv, verav acha bar yaakov peshita leh dimammer chayyayv. mar savar ha mihat la mesappeka, umar savar ha mihat la mesappeka.

Tanu rabbanan: mekoshesh ze tzelafchad, vechen hu omer: "vayyihyu vene yisrael bammidbar vayyimtzeu ish vegomer", ulehallan hu omer: "avinu met bammidbar", ma lehallan tzelafchad, af kan tzelafchad — divre rabbi akiva.
Amar lo rabbi yehuda ben betira: akiva, ben kach uven kach atta atid litten et haddin: im kidvarecha — hattora kissattu, veatta megalle oto?! veim lav — atta motzi laaz al oto tzaddik.

a: Veella ha gamar gezera shava! gezera shava la gamar. ella mehecha hava? mivvayyapilu" hava.

Kayyotze baddavar, atta omer: "vayyichar af Adonai bam vayyelach" — melammed sheaf aharon nitztara, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yehuda ben betira: akiva, ben kach uven kach atta atid litten et haddin. im kidvarecha — hattora kissattu veatta megalle oto?! veim lav — atta motzi laaz al oto tzaddik.
Veella hachtiv "bam"! hahu binzifa bealma. tanya keman deamar af aharon nitztara, dichtiv: "vayyifen aharon el miryam vehinne metzoraat", tana: sheppana mitztzarato.

Amar resh lakish: hachoshed bichsherim — loke begufo, dichtiv: "vehen lo yaaminu li vegomer", vegalya kamme kudesha berich hu dimhemni yisrael. amar lo: hen maaminim bene maaminim, veatta en sofcha lehaamin.

Hen maaminim, dichtiv: "vayyaamen haam". bene maaminim — "veheemin bayya". atta en sofcha lehaamin, shenneemar: "yaan lo heemantem bi vegomer". mimmay dilka, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai lo od have na yadcha bechekecha vegomer".

Amar rava, veittema rabbi yose berabbi chanina: midda tova memaheret lavo mimmiddat pureanut. deillu bemiddat pureanut ketiv: "vayyotziah vehinne yado metzoraat kashshaleg", veillu bemidda tova ketiv: "vayyotziah mecheko vehinne shava kivsaro" — mecheko hu deshava kivsaro.
"Vayyivla matte aharon et mattotam", amar rabbi elazar: nes betoch nes.
Mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid.

Bae rabba: lematta measara peligi, uveha peligi — demar savar amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha, umar savar la amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha. aval lemala measara — divre hakkol patur, vela yalfinan zorek mimmoshit.

O dilma: lemala measara peligi, uveha peligi — demar savar yalfinan zorek mimmoshit, umar savar la yalfinan zorek mimmoshit. aval lematta measara — divre hakkol chayyayv, may tama? — keluta kema shehunnecha damya.

Amar rav yosef: ha milleta ibbaya leh lerav chisda, ufashta nihaleh rav hamenuna meha: mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid veover birshut harabbim atzmah — rabbi akiva mechayyev, vachachamim potrim. middekaamar "birshut harabbim atzmah", peshita lematta measara peligi.

Uvemay? ilema bemaavir, lematta measara — hu dimchayyev, lemala measara — la mechayyev? vehaamar rabbi elazar: hammotzi massoy lemala measara — chayyayv, shekken massa bene kehat. ella lav bezorek, ulematta measara hu dimchayyev, lemala measara — la mechayyev, shema minna bikluta kema shehunnecha peligi. shema minna.
Ufeliga derabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: mechayyev haya rabbi akiva afillu lemala measara, vehay dekatane "reshut harabbim atzmah" — lehodiacha kochan derabbanan.

Ufeliga derav chilkiyya bar tovi, daamar rav chilkiyya bar tovi: toch shelosha — divre hakkol chayyayv. lemala measara — divre hakkol patur. mishshelosha vead asara — banu lemachloket rabbi akiva verabbanan.

Tanya name hachi: betoch shelosha — divre hakkol chayyayv, lemala measara — eno ella mishshum shevut. veim hayu reshuyot shello — muttar. mishshelosha vead asara — rabbi akiva mechayyev vachachamim potrin.

Amar mar: im hayu reshuyot shello — muttar. lema tihve teyuveteh derav, deittemar: shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, rabba bar rav huna amar rav: asur lizrok mizze laze. ushemuel amar: muttar lizrok mizze laze. velav mi okemna lehahi kegon demiddele chad umittatte chad — dezimnin nafel, veate leetuye.

Amar leh rav chisda lerav hamenuna, veamri la rav hamenuna lerav chisda: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: kol pachot mishshelosha — kelavud dame? amar leh: lefi shei efshar lah lirshut harabbim shettillaket bemalket uverahitane.
I hachi, shelosha name? vetu, ha ditnan: hameshalshel defanot millemala lematta, im hen gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim — pesula. ha pachot mishshelosha — keshera.
Hatam hayeynu tama, mishshum dehavya la mechitza shehaggedayim bokin bah. tinach lematta, lemala may ikka lememar? ella kol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame — hilcheta gemiri la.

Tanu rabbanan: mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim ureshut hayyachid baemtza — rabbi mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: lo chiyyev rabbi ella birshut hayyachid mekore, deamrinan beta keman demalya dame, aval sheeno mekore la. amar rav chana amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mechayyev haya rabbi shetayim — achat mishshum hotzaa, veachat mishshum hachenasa.
Yatev rav chana veka kashya leh:
b: Lememra dimchayyev rabbi attolada bimkom av?
Vehatanya, rabbi omer: "devarim" "haddevarim" "elle haddevarim" — ellu sheloshim vatesha melachot shenneemru lemoshe besinay!
Amar leh rav yosef: mar aha matne la, vekashya leh derabbi adderabbi. anan adderabbi yehuda matninan — vela kashya lan.
Detanya: mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim veavar arba ammot birshut harabbim — rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda shetayim — achat mishshum hotzaa veachat mishshum haavara. dei salka datach chada hu dimchayyev, mikkelal derabbanan patri ligmare? ha appek la mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach rabbi yehuda chada hu dimchayyev, verabbanan patri ligmare, vehechi mashkachat la? kegon deamar ad denafka leh lirshut harabbim tenuch.

Uveha kamippalgi, derabbi yehuda savar: amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha, veitavida leh machshavto. verabbanan savri: la amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha, vela itavida leh machshavto! aval attolada bimkom av la mechayyev rabbi yehuda.

La salka datach, detanya: rabbi yehuda mosif af hashshovet vehamedakdek. amru lo: shovet hare hu bichlal mesech, medakdek hare hu bichlal oreg. may lav deavdinhu letarvavyyhu bahade hadade, ushema minna mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda attolada bimkom av!
Mimmay? dilma leolam deavda leha lechudda veha lechudda, verabbi yehuda attolada bimkom av la mechayyev, uveha kamippalgi: derabbi yehuda savar hane avot ninhu, verabbanan savri hane toldot ninhu.

Teda, dekatane "rabbi yehuda mosif". i amrat bishlama avot, may mosif — mosif avot. ella i amrat toladot, may mosif? ittemar name, rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: lo chiyyev rabbi yehuda ella achat.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ulemay dislek addatin meikkara dimchayyev haya rabbi yehuda shetayim? i lehacha kavae la — lehacha la kavae la. i lehacha kavae la — lehacha la kavae la. amar leh: beomer "kol makom shettirtze — tanuach".

Peshita nitkavvevn lizrok shemone vezarak arba — hare katav "shem" mishshimon. nitkavvevn lizrok arba vezarak shemone — mahu? mi amrinan: ha appek leh, o dilma: hecha devae, ha la nach. velav hayeynu daamar leh ravina lerav ashe, vaamar leh: beomer "kol makom shettirtze tanuach".
Udekaamrat hare katav "shem" mishshimon, mi dame? hatam kamma dela ketiv "shem" la mikketiv leh "shimon", hacha kamma dela zarek arba — la mizdarki leh tamne?!
Tanu rabbanan: hazzorek mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim ureshut hayyachid baemtza, arba ammot — chayyayv,

a: Pachot mearba ammot — patur. may ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan: reshuyot mitztarfot — udela amrinan keluta kema shehunnecha.

Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rav abba, amar rav huna, amar rav: hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim mekore — patur, lefi sheeno dome ledigle midbar. ini?! veha agalot dimkorot havyayn, veamar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: agalot, tachtehen uvenehen vetziddehen reshut harabbim! ki kaamar rav bedarata.

Mikkede, ureka daagala kamma havay — chamesh ammin, puteya dekeresh kamma havay — ammeta ufalga, kamma motev — telata, pash leh palga deammeta, ki shade leh mar bene uvene — kelavud dame! mi savrat kerashim apputayyhu hava mannach lehu? achuddan mannach lehu.

Sof sof sumecha dekeresh kamma have — ammeta, kamma hava motiv — arbea, pasha la ammeta, ki shade la mar bene uvene, kelavud dame. hanicha leman deamar kerashim millemattan ovyayn amma, millemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba — shappir. ella leman deamar keshem shemmillemattan ovyayn amma kach millemalan ovyayn amma, may ikka lememar?
Amar rav kahana: beatbee! atbee hecha mannach lehu — aggabba daagala, agala gufa mekora havay.
b: Amar shemuel: bitedot.

Tanu rabbanan: kerashim millemattan ovyayn amma, umillemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba, shenneemar: "yihyu tammim al rosho", ulehallan hu omer: "tammu nichratu". divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi nechemya omer: keshem shemmillemattan ovyayn amma, kach millemalan ovyayn amma, shenneemar: "yachdav".
Vehachtiv "tammim"! hahu deleto shalmin vela leto denisra. veiddach name, hachtiv "yachdav"! hahu dela lishalchofinhu mehadade.

Bishlama leman deamar keshem shemmillemattan ovyayn amma kach millemalan ovyayn amma, hayeynu dichtiv: "uleyarkete hammishkan yamma taase shishsha kerashim. ushene kerashim taase limkutzot" — deate puteya dehane, memalle leh lesumecha dehane. ella leman deamar millemattan ovyayn amma, millemalan kalin veholchin ad keetzba, hay ayel vehay nafek! deshafe lehu ki turin.
"Vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim", tana: benes haya omed.

"Veet hammishkan taase eser yeriot ... orech hayeria haachat shemone veesrim baamma". shedi urekayyhu lefuteya demishkan, kamma havya — esrin vetamne. dal asar leiggara — pashu lehu tesha lehay gisa vetesha lehay gisa. lerabbi yehuda miggalleya amma daadanim, lerabbi nechemya miggalleya amma dikrashim.
Shedi putayyhu leureke demishkan, kamma havya — arbein. dal telatin leiggara — pasha lehu asar, lerabbi yehuda, mikkasseya amma daadanim lerabbi nechemya miggalleya amma daadanim.

"Veasita yeriot izzim leohel vegomer orech hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma vegomer". shedi urekayyhu lefuteya demishkan, kamma havya — telatin, dal asar leiggara, pashu lehu asar lehay gisa vaasar lehay gisa. lerabbi yehuda mikkasseya amma daadanim, lerabbi nechemya miggalleya amma daadanim.

Tanya name hachi: "vehaamma mizze vehaamma mizze baodef" — lechassot amma shel adanim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi nechemya omer: lechassot amma shel kerashim. shedi putayyhu leurekeh demishkan, kamma havya? arbein vearbee. dal telatin leiggara — pashu lehu arbesre. dal tarte lechafla, dichtiv: "vechafalta et hayeria hashshishshit el mul pene haohel" — pashu lehu tarte sere.

Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, hayeynu dichtiv: "chatzi hayeria haodefet tisrach". ella lerabbi nechemya, may "tisrach"? tisrach mechavroteha. tana deve rabbi yishmael: lema mishkan dome — leishsha shemhallechet bashshuk veshippuleha mehallechin achareha.
